jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bounty

Bounty has supported UK parents since 1959, when it launched with hospital-given packs for new
mothers, and today reaches millions of families each year through the Bounty app, prenatal packs in
clinical settings, and bounty.com. Bounty is part of Joy, an AI-powered parenting platform that pairs
certified experts with AI to give parents round-the-clock support, alongside sister brands and
services across the group.

The Bounty app and bounty.com support hundreds of thousands of parents each month through
pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood. We're now investing in a full modernisation of the platform
behind that experience — a ground-up rebuild designed to give the business a faster, more flexible
foundation for years to come. We're hiring the person who'll lead that rebuild.

The role in brief

Come in, understand what we've built to date, then design and build a modern replacement for the
backend APIs that power the mobile app and website. Preserve the existing users, their data, and
our search ranking through the move. Then rebuild the website on the new backend.

What you'll be doing

Understand the current platform
Get familiar with our current environment: Sitecore, SQL Server and .NET on Azure IaaS, along with a network of scheduled tasks, SFTP feeds and partner integrations built up over time.
Some areas are better documented than others, so part of the role is building a clear, first-hand picture by exploring the code and observing the live systems directly, supported by AI tooling to move quickly.
Document your findings and recommended approach: target stack, migration plan, realistic timeline, risks, and how we keep the app and website running throughout the rebuild.

Rebuild the backend
Design and build the replacement backend API from scratch. We already have the mobile app's API contract documented (OpenAPI 3.1 spec, around 40 endpoints, mapped from the app codebases). The new backend needs to match that contract so we don't have to re-ship the app.
Migrate existing users and their data (accounts, permissions, engagement history, vouchers, editorial content) into the new data model. Nobody should have to re-register.
Switch over from the current backend once you're confident, with a written rollback plan you've tested in advance.

Rebuild the website
SEO is the biggest priority to protect. Rebuild bounty.com off Sitecore onto a modern stack you propose and we agree together. The site ranks well, and that ranking is worth real money, so URLs, redirects and structured data all need to carry over cleanly.

Keep it running
Once the move is complete, the day-to-day is keeping the new stack healthy and making sure integrations (Klaviyo, Purchasely, partner feeds) stay reliable. Our React-based Voucher
Management System sits with you too, both keeping it running and picking up feature work on it.
You'll also keep the analytics pipelines healthy (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Mixpanel) so the business team can rely on them for reporting.

Build what's next
With solid foundations in place, you'll work with the Bounty team on their product roadmap: new
features, improvements to what's there, and whatever the business needs from a platform built to
move quickly. This is where the rebuild starts paying off.

Who you are

Non-negotiables
Lead-level full-stack engineer. You can own a whole system yourself, from database through backend and frontend to deployment and monitoring, and you're comfortable making the architectural calls. You'll own this project end-to-end, with our mobile app engineers available to support you where the app side needs input.
Strong production backend in Node/TypeScript. We're standardising on TypeScript across the stack, so this role can extend into other engineering work at Bounty (and sister brand Joy) over time. React/TypeScript on the frontend is a given.
API design discipline. REST, OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation. You've kept a client-consumed API stable over time.
Comfort with established systems. You don't need prior experience with our specific stack, but you're comfortable getting to grips with systems that are new to you — reading the actual code and running the actual systems rather than guessing.
Sensible use of AI-assisted development. You use AI tools day-to-day and know when to trust them and when not to, especially around company data, IP, and hallucinations.
Clear writing. You can put together a technical proposal or a handover document without hand-holding. You'll be writing for non-technical stakeholders throughout.
Good judgement about scope. You know when to park a nice-to-have because it's holding up the critical path, and when to flag a scope risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

Nice to have
You've led a live data migration before, at real scale, without losing data or breaking things. You understand why dual-write, reconciliation and a rehearsed cutover matter.
SEO awareness (URL preservation, canonical tags, structured data, redirect chains).
Azure and/or GCP experience. We're on Azure today and moving toward GCP to align with the wider organisation.

Explicitly not required
Please don't rule yourself out because you haven't used our specific stack or third-party tools before.
None of that is a blocker, the parts that matter, you'll pick up quickly.

What we offer

Salary range £90k–£115k, depending on experience.
Remote (UK), with occasional in-person time for team offsites.
25 days holiday.
Pension: 3% employer + 5% personal contribution.
Life assurance at 2x salary.
Option to enrol in private medical cover after a 6-month probation.
Genuinely interesting work: you'll build something modern from scratch with real autonomy, rather than shipping small features on an existing platform.
A well-established brand with a loyal, sizeable audience — hundreds of thousands of parents will be using what you build.

How to apply

Send a CV plus a short note (under 400 words) covering:
The most complex legacy or platform rebuild you've led, and what surprised you about it.
One thing you'd want to understand about our current setup before committing to a target architecture.

Applications via LinkedIn only. Closing date: 30 September 2026.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)

We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. Collaborate with cross-functional teammates (product, researchers, solution architects, domain experts) and participate in team practices such as PR reviews, while building confidence in providing feedback.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent hands-on experience) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Maths/Physics, or a related field.
1–3 years of practical coding experience through a mix of internships, junior roles, university projects, open-source, or personal projects.
Experience building end-to-end applications or prototypes, covering both backend and basic frontend components.
Working knowledge of at least one backend stack (e.g., Python, Rust, Java, Node.js, C) and a willingness to learn new tools as needed.
Familiarity with REST APIs, basic database concepts (relational and/or NoSQL), and software engineering fundamentals (testing, debugging, modular design, incremental delivery).
Comfortable using Git and common team workflows (branches, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD).
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code/Codex), with an understanding that generated code must be reviewed and validated.
Exposure to containers (Docker/Podman/Apptainer) and at least one cloud platform (Azure/AWS/GCP).
Initial experience with edge and autonomous deployments, for example deploying software to constrained devices or platforms such as robots, drones, gateways, or on-prem edge servers, including awareness of reliability and connectivity
Able to work in ambiguous problem spaces, ask good questions, learn quickly, and communicate clearly in English; willing to travel occasionally for workshops, demos, and prototype validation.

As our new Engineering Architect, you will own and evolve the technical foundations that underpin product and service delivery, including engineering standards, development frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing harnesses, observability, and operational practices.

Your focus will be on enabling a fast-moving, AI-first delivery team to consistently deliver high-quality, scalable, and supportable solutions without needing to rebuild core foundations for every delivery cycle.

What you'll do

In this varied role, you will:
own and version technical foundations across all seven harness dimensions (Security, performance, coding style, UI/UX baselines, logging and observability, testing) so that every deliverable inherits secure, observable and tested defaults
build and maintain the shared ADO CI/CD pipelines and release governance so that standards are enforced automatically, and DORA metrics are produced from the pipeline itself
own the light-touch technical governance model - automated gates over committee review
ensure observability is instrumented from the first commit through to live running so that everything the team ships can be operated and handed over to a receiving product team
contribute hands-on as a full-stack builder inside each delivery's time box so that the harness stays credible and drift is caught in days rather than at cycle end
own the design and hands-on running of the delivery stack end to end - application architecture, containerisation, virtualisation, networking and deployment topology - so that what the team builds can be stood up, scaled and supported in the Azure estate without external dependency
shape deliveries as one of three leads, testing technical feasibility and setting the no-gos, so that committed work stays inside its appetite
represent the team's technical position in assurance, security and enterprise architecture conversations
proactively track industry trends, emerging tools and agentic engineering practice, and self-initiate the learning needed to apply them - trialling promising techniques and approaches in cooldown and sharing what works back into the harness, rules files and skills library.

What you'll need

We are looking for:
deep, current full stack engineering capability with hands-on delivery in an Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO) ecosystem using infrastructure as code approaches
strong practical coding experience in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the fluency to work across back-end services, front-end interfaces and automation scripting
sound stack design judgement, with working knowledge of containerisation, virtualisation and networking sufficient to design, deploy and troubleshoot applications across Azure environments
proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, release governance and DORA-based delivery measurement
strong grounding in security (secret management, dependency and static analysis scanning, least-privilege IAM), observability (structured logging, tracing and metrics) and test and evaluation automation
practical experience of AI-first, agentic delivery - rules files, known-good templates, curated skills libraries and evaluation harnesses for AI-generated output
ability to codify standards as machine-readable scaffolding rather than documentation, and to balance light-touch governance against delivery speed
credibility to represent the team's technical position with enterprise architecture, security and assurance functions
experience designing and delivering production-grade AI software systems across different domains
proven expertise in designing and/or implementing generative AI systems in production, including agentic systems, RAG pipelines, tool-use patterns, and model adaptation strategies
practical experience in retrieval and knowledge systems
breadth of knowledge across modern AI technologies, including generative models, deep learning, and predictive ML.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that BIM requirements are embedded from project inception through design, construction, handover and operational readiness.

Working closely with the clients Design and Construction stakeholders, designers, contractors and specialist trade partners, you will drive compliance with BIM Requirements, ISO 19650 processes and digital twin objectives, ensuring that all project information is delivered in a structured, coordinated and operationally useful manner. The role will also play a key part in preparing project information for integration into Autodesk Tandem and future operational digital twin environments.

Information management leadership

Manage the implementation of BIM and Information Management processes in accordance with ISO 19650.
Act as the primary BIM and Digital Delivery lead for the project.

Provide strategic guidance to designers, contractors and trade contractors on BIM implementation.

Conduct BIM maturity and supply-chain capability assessments.

Ensure coordination issues are identified, assigned and resolved.

Drive accountability across the supply chain to ensure BIM deliverables are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

Asset information and digital twin readiness

Review COBie deliverables and asset metadata quality.
Ensure information required for operations and facilities management is captured progressively throughout the project.
Support the development and population of the Asset Information Model (AIM).

Build strong relationships with the clients Design and Construction teams, consultants and contractors.
Present BIM performance, risks and recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
Support procurement activities by reviewing BIM capability, methodologies and tender responses.

Significant experience in BIM, Digital Engineering or Information Management.
Proven experience leading BIM delivery on major commercial, mixed-use, data centre or corporate workplace developments.
Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and contractors.
Strong knowledge of BIM governance, model assurance and information management workflows.
Experience developing and reviewing BIM Execution Plans, MIDPs and project information requirements.

ISO 19650 series.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

The Structured Finance (SF) Methodologies team is responsible for a large portfolio of criteria and models spanning the global SF universe, including CMBS, RMBS, CLO, Covered Bonds, Non-Traditional and ABS asset types. The criteria and models that the group develops and maintains help analysts produce independent credit ratings that increase S&P Global’s analytical relevance in the market. As a Methodology Model SME, the position is embedded within the SF team and works closely with the Model and Criteria SMEs, who are responsible for developing and maintaining a growing portfolio of cutting-edge quantitative tools and analysis that enable analysts to continually produce high-quality and transparent credit analysis.

The Impact

The Associate Director enhances S&P Global Ratings’ ability to produce high-impact, insightful research and models and supports the continued growth of S&P Global Ratings’ relevance in an evolving market by synthesizing, analyzing, and deriving value from datasets, developing innovative analytic solutions and tools, and helping to build data analytics capabilities across the SF team.

What’s in it for you?

The role leverages quantitative abilities to develop analytic solutions and tools that enable credit analysts to perform high-quality analysis and research.
The position explores new areas for research and aids in business development initiatives. It supervises and performs implementation and testing of quantitative models as prototypes and production engines using the Quantitative Toolbox as appropriate, to further the study, application and acceptance of quantitative methodologies as part of the firm’s businesses.
The role offers a challenging, steep learning curve, and the position could lead to continued growth within the organization by demonstrating strong analysis and presentation skills.
Gain analytic knowledge of a wide range of global sectors and market topics.
Gain exposure to stakeholders across S&P Ratings and enjoy a strong collegial, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain nimble, user-friendly quantitative solutions and tools that will be used by credit analysts globally in credit rating analyses and research publications.
Synthesize and analyze large datasets to derive analytic value and insights for credit rating analyses and research publications.
Proactively identify and implement creative solutions to drive continuous improvement across models and analytical workflows.
Provide analytical insight and technical guidance to help the team resolve complex, non-routine problems and tasks.
Maintain close interaction with analysts, model developers, and subject matter experts to ensure that data analyses and tools effectively inform analytical decisions.
Work closely with the Model and Criteria Validation group to ensure a high-quality product.
Write clear, concise specifications and development documentation to ensure consistent and thorough documentation in accordance with policy and procedures.
Support criteria projects and be an active member of projects, including testing of new concepts, data gathering, writing and preparation of materials.
Coach and guide junior developers on technical tasks and best practices; support criteria projects by assisting with tool development, testing, and data gathering 

Compensation / Benefits Information

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,491 to $176,000 USD (This section is only applicable to US Candidates). Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries.

Basic Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 5 to 7 years of experience in quantitative modeling or software development supporting financial analysis.
Knowledge of capital markets and financial instruments, with an emphasis on credit risk modeling preferred.
Basic understanding of database modeling/design and applications, including knowledge of SQL and experience in databases such as Oracle, Sybase, or Access.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/VBA and programming languages such as R, Python, C++, and MATLAB.
Persistent with a natural curiosity about credit markets and technical details.
Displays well-rounded communication skills that implement good listening techniques, clear and good verbal skills. The ability to communicate across a wide range of groups and personalities internally and externally.
Works well in a team environment, focusing on collaboration and adapting to the needs of a diverse team.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field 
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
Able to summarize complex quantitative concepts clearly and concisely for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting multi-stage projects from planning through execution.
Strong time management, prioritization and deadline-management skills.
Effective communication, interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder-management skills.
Creative problem-solver who works well in fast-paced environments.
We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

The qualifications you need:

Proven experience of 5+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).
Eligibility for UK Security Check (SC) clearance is required; existing clearance is a strong advantage.
Very good understanding of best practices in deploying, scaling, and maintaining highly available, secure and resilient containerized applications on Kubernetes, ensuring efficient resource utilization and operational stability.
Proven experience implementing infrastructure as code (IaC, e.g. with Terraform) is required; Helm or Kustomize experience is strongly preferred. Fluency with additional tools such as ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, etc., is a plus.
Experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) would be a plus.
Experience & interest in working with modern tech stack & methods like REST/SOAP API-Management, Data Ingestion & Streaming (Kafka or similar), SSO, LDAP, IT Security, Agile, etc.
Experience in industry with experience to work on Python, SQL, data pipelines & ETL processes for large volumes of data is a plus.
Knowledgeable about security and compliance topics for enterprise applications.Solid experience with project management, outstanding customer-centric & proven experience working with customers.
A solution-oriented professional that enjoys deep technical discussions as much as transferring your technical knowledge into understandable terms to a broader audience

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

jobs.description:
Job description
Servent is a Microsoft Solutions Partner helping organisations harness the power of Cloud, Data, Security and AI to drive transformation and business growth. We specialise in designing and delivering modern Microsoft technology solutions that enable customers to become secure, data-driven and AI-enabled enterprises.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Data and AI Architect to help customers unlock the value of their data, accelerate AI adoption and shape the evolution of Servent's Data and AI capability.

ROLE OVERVIEW 

As Servent continues to expand its Data and AI capability, we are seeking an experienced Data and AI Architect to help grow our Data and AI practice and deliver transformative customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on role combining customer advisory, solution architecture, technical leadership and business growth responsibilities. You will work with customers, Microsoft and Servent delivery teams to design modern Data and AI solutions, support pre-sales opportunities and deliver successful customer outcomes.

You will lead discovery workshops, define solution architectures, support the evolution of Servent's Data and AI offerings and help establish Servent as a recognised leader in Azure Data, Analytics and AI transformation.

KEY OBJECTIVES

The successful candidate will:

Develop innovative Data and AI offerings aligned to Microsoft's strategic priorities.
Support the growth of Data and AI revenue through customer engagement and pre-sales activity.
Support Servent's Advanced Specialisation, Solution Partner Designation and marketplace growth objectives.

SUCCESS IN ROLE

Success in role will be measured by:

Support the growth of qualified Data and AI pipeline and revenue.
Creation of repeatable Data and AI service offerings and accelerators.
Successful delivery of high-quality, profitable customer engagements.
Positive customer outcomes, advocacy and repeat engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

Data and AI Practice

Support the development and growth of Servent's Data and AI practice, ensuring alignment with business objectives, market opportunities and Microsoft's strategic direction.
Define and evolve Servent's Data and AI service offerings, methodologies, accelerators and delivery frameworks.
Establish architectural standards, governance principles and quality frameworks to ensure consistent delivery excellence across customer engagements.
Act as a trusted technical leader, mentoring consultants, engineers and architects while promoting knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Customer Advisory and Consulting

Engage with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, challenges and strategic priorities.
Carry out data maturity assessments to help clients map out their data strategy.
Facilitate discovery workshops, envisioning sessions and architecture reviews to help customers develop Data and AI roadmaps.
Translate business requirements into scalable, secure and cost-effective Data and AI solutions.
Provide strategic guidance on data transformation, analytics modernisation, governance and AI adoption.
Develop trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and become a recognised advisor on Data and AI strategy.

Solution Architecture and Delivery

Architect and oversee the delivery of enterprise-scale Data and AI solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Design modern data platforms using technologies including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Purview, Azure Data Explorer, Synapse Analytics and Power BI.
Apply data and semantic modelling best practices including dimensional modelling to deliver consistent, trusted and high-performing analytics solutions.
Design and govern end-to-end architectures that deliver scalability, resilience, security, compliance and operational supportability.

AI and Modern Data Innovation

Design AI-ready data platforms that support advanced analytics, machine learning and Generative AI workloads.
Architect solutions leveraging Azure AI Services, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Fabric capabilities where appropriate.
Design Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, knowledge discovery solutions and intelligent data-driven applications.

Business Development and Pre-Sales

Support sales and account management teams in identifying, qualifying and developing Data and AI opportunities.
Contribute to proposal development, bid responses, solution estimates and Statements of Work.
Help shape customer business cases and articulate the value of Data and AI solutions.
Support the growth of the Data and AI practice through pipeline generation, customer expansion opportunities and strategic account development.
Represent Servent in customer engagements, industry events and Microsoft-led initiatives.

Microsoft Partnership and Market Engagement

Support the attainment and renewal of Microsoft Solution Partner Designations and Advanced Specialisations relevant to Data and AI.
Contribute to joint Microsoft and customer engagements, workshops and go-to-market activities.

Internal Data and Business Enablement

Support the evolution of Servent's internal data and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to leverage data, automation and AI to improve operational effectiveness and decision-making.

SKILLS 

Professional Experience

We are seeking an experienced Data and AI Architect with a proven track record of designing, delivering and leading enterprise-scale Data and AI solutions within consulting, professional services or customer-facing technology environments.

The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across the following areas:

Consulting and Customer Engagement

Proven experience leading customer workshops, discovery sessions and strategic advisory engagements.
Ability to translate business objectives into practical Data and AI roadmaps and technical solutions.
Strong consulting skills with the ability to influence decisions, challenge assumptions and guide customers through technology transformation initiatives.

Solution Architecture

Significant experience architecting and delivering modern Azure-based Data and AI platforms.
Experience leading complex transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and operational handover.
Ability to provide technical leadership across multiple projects whilst ensuring consistent quality and delivery excellence.

Data and AI Expertise

Demonstrable experience designing modern data platforms supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning and AI workloads.
Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, master data management, governance and data lifecycle management.
Experience implementing scalable and secure data solutions capable of supporting advanced analytics and AI-enabled business outcomes.
Understanding of emerging AI technologies and their practical application within enterprise environments.
Advise customers on data governance and AI adoption, including ownership, quality, lineage, privacy, responsible AI controls, data readiness assessments and operationalisation.

Leadership and Collaboration

Experience mentoring, coaching and supporting the development of engineers, consultants and architects.
Strong written, verbal and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience leading technical discussions and presenting to executive-level stakeholders.

Commercial and Business Awareness

Experience supporting business development activities including workshops, proposals, solution design and customer presentations.
Understanding of project commercials, solution estimation and the delivery of profitable consulting engagements.
Experience contributing to service development, go-to-market initiatives and business growth is highly desirable.

Technical Experience

The successful candidate will possess strong experience across several of the following technology areas:
Core Experience

Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure Databricks
Azure data platform architecture
Modern data platform design and delivery
Customer-facing consulting and advisory services

Desirable

Azure Synapse Analytics
Azure Data Explorer
Microsoft Purview
Power BI
Azure SQL and SQL Server platforms

Data Engineering and Analytics

Data integration and ETL/ELT design
Data warehousing methodologies
Medallion architecture and modern Lakehouse design
Data modelling and information architecture
Streaming and near real-time data platforms
Advanced analytics and reporting solutions
Machine Learning and Large Language Models

Azure AI and Modern Data Solutions

Microsoft Foundry
Azure OpenAI Service
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
AI-ready data platform design
Intelligent document processing and knowledge discovery
Responsible AI and AI governance principles

Development and DevOps

Python and/or C#
Azure DevOps
GitHub
CI/CD pipelines and automation
Infrastructure as Code principles
Software engineering and DevOps best practices

Certifications

Candidates should hold one or more relevant Microsoft certifications and demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Desirable certifications include:
Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Together with clients and third-party vendors, you’ll have a desire to lead and be part of a collaborative team taking a holistic approach across the system helping shape strategy, requirements and technology to deliver outstanding results.

You will have a drive, determination and the soft skills to seek consensus and compromise in order to engage client architects and other stakeholders and take them through the technical aspects of business transformation from business needs to fully delivered and implemented solution.

Whether it’s a strategy and transformation or implementation programme, your advice will help our clients to operate more efficiently and effectively. What’s more, you’ll be pivotal in helping to drive forward some of the most exciting products currently in development in the UK.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Collaborating with clients, consultants and delivery teams to determine business-specific solution needs.
Define and architect solutions to clients Digital Engineering needs, both business and technical.
Determine, create and maintain architectural artifacts (e.g. documentation, models) through all phases of a project.
Technically lead large and/or complex projects and support the Project Manager to meet business needs, governance approvals and delivery timescales. Includes compiling and implementing application development plans.
Provide leadership and technical direction at all levels in the team to meet challenges throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide strategic and enterprise level input to aid clients in constructing a holistic solution across their data and application landscape.
Where not present, bring architectural principles and thinking to a project including documenting architectural processes, procedures and standards.
Identifying application integration requirements, maintenance needs, upgrades, and data migration activities.
Identify opportunities to eliminate complexity, simplify end-to-end workflows, automate manual tasks and deploy AI across operations.
You will be responsible for mentoring junior architects and other team members, guiding and encouraging the use of best practise techniques.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

The ideal candidate will be employed in a major engineering organisation or in a leading consulting or digital technology firm. Our preference is that they will have experience of operating in similar Senior roles within the sector.

Knowledge of the digital solutions within the Product Engineering domain
Be able to provide evidence based architectural options, alternatives, rationales, and recommendations/solution evaluations.
Experience of technically leading large complex projects.
Proven ability to build new and maintain existing professional networks.
Establish and maintain skills and personal eminence in the market.
Continually develop expertise and knowledge of client issues based on accumulated experience.

Build and manage trusted relationships with client architects at all levels, strengthening IBM Consulting services capabilities.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Ability to learn new methods, approaches and tools.

Ability to perform analytical thinking and problem solving and communicate the outcomes.
Leadership skills (provide guidance, delegation, communication (written/verbal) and encourage ideas and options).
Understand the importance of data and its governance, strategy, integrations and insights that it can supply to a business.
Understanding and appreciation of business process and its role in Digital Engineering transformations.
Communicate articulately and effectively, with an appropriate level of detail but retaining key messages, at all levels of business
Excellent relationship building skills i.e. upon joining a new team, quickly build relationships to ensure solutions cover and complement all aspects of business needs and wider transformation (e.g. processes).
Ability to support requirements gathering and process modelling activities.
PLM skills and experience. Ideally with successful delivery of solutions utilising key PLM Packages (such as Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, Windchill or equivalent).

This is a great opportunity to join BearingPoint at a pivotal moment of growth and investment and be part of a community of like-minded consultants. We are proud to operate as a “boutique style” cohort of inspired and passionate experts in our field with focus on innovation, collaboration, and customer success.

BearingPoint is looking for an experienced AI Workplace Solution Architect (M365 and AI) to own the end-to-end design of secure, AI-enabled Microsoft 365 environments for our clients. This is a senior client-facing consulting role focused on solution architecture, Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent platforms, data and security architecture, and technical assurance across multi-workload transformation projects.

Architecture & Solution Design

Own the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft 365 and AI workplace projects, covering SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, and the Power Platform.
Define target-state designs, reference architectures, and migration roadmaps that move clients from legacy platforms onto Microsoft 365 with an AI-ready information architecture.

Set architectural standards for identity, conditional access, tenant configuration, and cross-tenant or multi-tenant operating models.

Technical Assurance & Delivery Leadership

Act as design authority across delivery teams, reviewing solutions for security, scalability, performance, and cost.
Own technical risk, dependency, and interdependency management across workstreams, and escalate clearly to project leadership.
Mentor engineers and consultants, and set development, deployment, and documentation standards using Azure DevOps.

Lead architecture workshops, design authority boards, and executive briefings, translating technical decisions into business outcomes.
Support pre-sales by shaping solution approaches, effort estimates, and technical responses to client requirements.
Contribute to internal reference architectures and reusable assets for future client engagements.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
10+ years in Microsoft 365 and collaboration platform delivery, including at least 3 years in a solution architecture or design authority role.

We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI
to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.
Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB
Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.
Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.
Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.
Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.
Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.
AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).
Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

Ideally you’ll have/be:

Software Engineering Foundation: Strong hands-on experience in Node.js / TypeScript and React. You know how to write code from scratch, which is why you’re so good at prompting AI to do it for you.
GenAI Power User: Deep experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to build apps, debug complex issues, and accelerate the development lifecycle. You aren't just using an AI assistant; you are "vibe coding" complete PoCs.
API Design Expert: Experience designing clean, well-documented APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and using Git/Github workflows effectively.
Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with AWS primitives and a proven ability to deploy infrastructure using Terraform.
Pragmatic & Autonomous: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, translating vague client requirements into working systems through a high degree of initiative.

What Will Set You Apart

The "Prototyper" Portfolio: A track record of building internal tools, sales demos, or high-fidelity PoCs using AI-first workflows.
Energy Sector Insight: Understanding the specific challenges facing energy retailers globally.
Auth & Security Savvy: Practical knowledge of OIDC-based authentication flows.
Design Thinking: A talent for sharing UX/UI design thinking with wider product teams.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Context

The Principal Consultant (Software Development) will design, build, and maintain high-performance software systems while acting as a technical reference point for less experienced team members. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and cross-functional teams to deliver features that are reliable, testable, and maintainable — contributing to architecture decisions and championing engineering best practices across the codebase

Missions/Main Duties

Design, develop, and maintain SYSTRA's proprietary microsimulation software Paramics Discovery using C++, C#, and Python across the full software development lifecycle.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code with a strong emphasis on testability and performance.
Participate in architectural and design discussions, contributing well-reasoned proposals and technical trade-off analysis.
Review code from peers and provide constructive, detailed feedback that raises the quality bar for the whole team.
Collaborate with DevOps colleagues to optimise CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth, repeatable deployments.
Interact with SQL databases - writing, reviewing, and optimising queries and stored procedures.
Mentor less experienced developers, supporting their technical growth and embedding best practices.
Contribute to test strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing.
Participate in agile ceremonies: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical refinements.
Demonstrate behaviours aligned with SYSTRA’s behavioural framework by actively fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, respect, and empowerment, contributing to an environment where all colleagues can thrive, achieve and grow together

Profile/Skills

Proficient in C++. Strong command of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), including memory management, templates, STL, and performance optimisation.

Proficient in Python: scripting, automation, data processing, or back-end service development.
Software Engineering Fundamentals: Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Debugging & Testing: Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g. Google Test, NUnit, pytest) and profiling / debugging complex systems.
Version Control: Comfortable with Git-based workflows including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
Communication: Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
configuration and deployment of solutions

Regulated Environments: Experience working in high-integrity, or regulated industries (e.g. defence, finance, transport, aerospace) is advantageous.

Mentor less experienced developers, supporting their technical growth and embedding best practices.

Participate in agile ceremonies: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical refinements.
Demonstrate behaviours aligned with SYSTRA’s behavioural framework by actively fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, respect, and empowerment, contributing to an environment where all colleagues can thrive, achieve and grow together.

Essential Skills / Knowledge / Experience

Proficient in C++. Strong command of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), including memory management, templates, STL, and performance optimisation.

configuration and deployment of solutions

SQL: Experience writing and optimising SQL queries, stored procedures, and working with large relational datasets.

Your Career

Lead, coach and develop a cross-functional engineering team.
Drive a culture of quality, test-driven development and continuous improvement.
Support the delivery of scalable, maintainable software and architecture.
Partner with Product teams to deliver against product roadmaps.
Remove delivery obstacles and improve team effectiveness.
Support recruitment, talent development and succession planning.
Champion AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and quality.

Experience leading or mentoring software engineers within Agile teams.
Strong software engineering background
Passion for engineering excellence, code quality and test-driven development.
Experience driving continuous improvement and high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Interest in modern engineering practices, cloud technologies and AI-assisted development.

Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave

You'll work closely with Product, Technology and Business leadership to ensure engineering delivers measurable business value whilst maintaining the highest standards of security, resilience and regulatory compliance.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical depth with proven leadership capability, helping to build a modern engineering organisation capable of delivering secure, scalable and high-performing products at pace.

This role requires a leader who remains close enough to technology to challenge decisions, support engineering teams and drive technical excellence whilst operating as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the engineering strategy for a portfolio of proprietary financial technology products.
Lead and develop a growing international engineering organisation.
Drive modern software engineering practices across product development, platform engineering and cloud services.
Partner with Product teams to align engineering delivery with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
Champion engineering excellence through automation, observability and data-driven decision making.
Drive improvements across deployment frequency, lead time, reliability and engineering performance metrics.
Lead adoption of modern architectures including cloud-native, microservices and event-driven systems.

Develop scalable engineering processes that support growth whilst maintaining agility.
Build strong relationships across Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Executive Leadership teams.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of hands on experience within software and product engineering.

3+ years leading engineering teams responsible for modern, business-critical financial platforms.
Direct ownership of end-to-end software engineering delivery, spanning development, cloud infrastructure, APIs and platform engineering.
Experience building and scaling high-performing engineering teams.
Strong knowledge of modern engineering practices, CI/CD, automation and DevOps.
Experience driving cloud transformation and modern architecture initiatives.
A strong understanding of engineering metrics and continuous improvement practices.
Knowledge of operational resilience, security and regulatory requirements within financial services.

Creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.
Challenging constructively and influencing senior stakeholders.
Balancing delivery, engineering quality and commercial outcomes.
Building credibility with both engineers and business leaders.
Leading through change and bringing people with you.

Most importantly, you'll be a builder. Someone who enjoys developing teams, improving engineering capability and shaping the future direction of a product-led technology organisation.

Influence the future direction of a growing global technology organisation.
Lead the evolution of business-critical financial platforms.
Work alongside senior leadership to shape technology strategy.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US 

At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For 

As a Developer in a self-organized Scrum team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain new features.
Take technical ownership of feature delivery, ensuring high quality, scalability, and performance.
Drive automation-first approach: design, implement, and maintain E2E, API, Integration tests.
Perform manual exploratory testing for complex scenarios.
Define test strategies at a feature/module level.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development.
Contribute to architectural discussions and participate in technical decision-making
Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools.
Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code).
Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

What We Value

We are looking for an experienced engineer with well-developed technical and collaborative skills

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
3+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework).
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications in .NET / C#.
Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD
Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices.
Comprehensive understanding of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures
Deep knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).
Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and building/managing pipelines
Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.
Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns with experience in Domain-Driven Design
Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, CI).
Experience with relational databases (SQL).
Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), written and spoken
Ability to mentor, guide, and inspire other developers.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.
Background in FinTech or capital markets.
Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is beneficial.

Benefits

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)
Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

About the Company

Aras is a leading provider of digital thread solutions for product lifecycle management (PLM) and engineering AI. As one of the fastest growing PLM companies, our AI-native, low-code platform enables the rapid delivery of flexible solutions that connect teams across disciplines and functions to critical product data and agentic AI throughout the product lifecycle and extended value chain. The world's largest manufacturers leverage Aras Innovator to manage complex product lifecycles, accelerate innovation, improve operational efficiency, and bring products to market faster. We collaborate with companies in some of the world's most innovative industries, including automotive, industrial equipment, aerospace and defense, high tech, and life sciences.

About the Role

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our L3 Support
engineering team and help resolve complex escalated issues in Aras Innovator, our enterprise low-code platform. In this role, you will investigate issues across the application stack, identify root causes, deliver fixes and improvements for customer-reported problems, and help improve platform stability across SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid deployment models.

Responsibilities

You will help diagnose, resolve, and prevent production issues affecting Aras Innovator customers.
Investigate complex issues and identify root causes across the application stack.
Drive escalated customer issues through analysis, fix development, testing, and deployment.
Develop enhancements, and product improvements that address customer-reported issues.
Evaluate technical approaches and work with product teams to refine solutions.
Support customer upgrades and adapt existing functionality to newer product versions.
Balance incoming escalations with planned improvement work as part of the team.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using modern engineering and AI-assisted development practices.
Use troubleshooting and profiling tools to diagnose performance and stability issues.
Improve CI/CD and DevOps practices to streamline the delivery process.
Enhance platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security.
Share knowledge and help improve support and engineering practices.

Qualifications

Commercial software development experience (3+ years with .net in production).

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of C# / .NET, with a solid understanding of OOP principles.
Experience with MS SQL Server and strong T-SQL.
Experience using troubleshooting, diagnostic, and profiling tools.
Good knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript.
Familiarity with REST APIs and HTTP-based standards such as OData.
Proficiency with Git or another distributed version control system.
Experience working in Agile or Kanban development environments.
Intermediate+ or higher English proficiency, both spoken and written.

Preferred Skills

Ability to use AI tools effectively in daily engineering work, including development, debugging, troubleshooting, and productivity tasks.
Experience working with large enterprise systems and legacy environments.
Experience with client-side development.
Direct experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS or Azure Container Apps), and Helm.
