jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments. The Staff Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader to help shape the future of identity recovery. You will contribute to the advancement of Netwrix Identity Recovery and key technologies across the platform, with opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into our products and development process. Working closely with engineers and product leaders, you'll influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and help deliver solutions that protect organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Write high-quality code and design scalable backend services for on-prem and SaaS environments, setting examples of technical excellence for the team and supporting key decisions on architecture, scalability, and integration
Develop and maintain recovery capabilities for Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments, ensuring broad identity coverage for enterprise customers
Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix's cybersecurity product platform and other ITDR products
Contribute to the product's evolution toward SaaS and cloud deployment, including containerization and cloud-native service design
Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
Utilize AI within Netwrix products to enable smarter recovery automation, anomaly identification, and predictive operations while ensuring accuracy
Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address issues, understand customer needs, and gather feedback on product features
Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to align technical direction with business needs
Mentor and support the growth of engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (BI & Analytics)
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As the founding Manager, Software Engineering for our new Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team
in Krakow, you have one of the most consequential roles in this new chapter of BlackLine's growth. This is a genuinely multi-disciplinary team - spanning data engineering, cloud data platforms, BI and analytics, and applied AI - and you will be the architect of the team itself: hiring and developing a world-class group of engineers across those disciplines, and shaping the culture, practices, and career trajectories of everyone in it.
You will lead the team through an ambitious delivery arc. You will start by standing up modern data pipelines - using Fabric database mirroring to move data from our Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical data model in Snowflake
- then build the modelling layer and surface insight to customers through Power BI
dashboards. From there, the team will develop true agentic AI experiences for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions (D&D), blending Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) patterns on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework.
You will partner closely with your senior engineers and cross-functional product leadership to ensure the team operates with clarity, urgency, and a high engineering bar. You will champion a culture of AI-accelerated development, where tools like Claude and Cursor are woven into the everyday fabric of how we build. This is not just a management role - it is a founding leadership role with an enduring impact on our mission to deliver autonomous finance and expand BlackLine's office-of-the-CFO footprint.

You'll Get To

Build and Scale the Krakow BI & Analytics Engineering Team:
Lead the hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team spanning data engineering, BI/analytics, and AI. Be an ambassador for BlackLine's engineering culture in the Krakow hub from day one.
Deliver the Snowflake Analytics Platform:
Own delivery of our modern data platform - Fabric database mirroring from Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical Snowflake data model, the Snowflake modelling and semantic layers, and customer-facing Power BI dashboards that turn that data into insight.
Lead the Agentic Experience Roadmap:
Guide the team from analytics into applied AI - building true agentic agents for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions management, delivering a mix of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) experiences on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework, integrated with our existing web applications.
Lead, Coach, and Grow Your Team:
Own the career development, performance, and wellbeing of your direct reports across a varied set of specialisms. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, and create growth paths that retain and attract top talent in a competitive Krakow market.
Drive Delivery and Execution:
Partner with Product Management to align on priorities, manage engineering capacity, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality software and data products on time. Remove blockers, manage risk, and keep commitments.
Champion AI-Accelerated Development:
Cultivate a team mindset and workflow that embraces modern agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force multipliers for velocity and quality - and hold the bar high for what great engineering looks like in this era.
Shape Engineering Culture and Standards:
Establish and uphold best practices across the full stack of the team's work - data pipeline reliability and observability, data quality and lineage, dimensional and semantic modelling standards, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and security. Set the tone for a culture of ownership, craft, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Serve as the primary engineering leadership voice in conversations with Product, Design, and senior stakeholders, and with the analytics and office-of-the-CFO consumers of the team's output. Translate business goals into actionable engineering plans and communicate engineering realities clearly to non-technical partners.
Contribute to Strategic Roadmap Planning:
Participate in quarterly and annual planning cycles, providing technical and capacity input that shapes the product roadmap, the data platform architecture, and long-term agentic-AI direction.
Sustain Enterprise-Grade Quality:
Ensure the team's output - data pipelines, analytics, and AI agents alike - meets the reliability, performance, accuracy, and security standards required by a global SaaS platform serving finance and accounting professionals worldwide.

Technical / Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams
in a SaaS product environment, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers at multiple seniority levels.
Strong technical foundation in data engineering and analytics
- hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and pipelines, ideally including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric
, and Power BI / DAX
, and dimensional or semantic data modelling - sufficient to earn trust with your engineers and make sound architectural trade-offs.
Solid grounding in application engineering
- production-grade, scalable, secure services, ideally in C# / .NET
- and comfort leading integration with modern web applications (React / C# / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).
Awareness of, or genuine enthusiasm for, building agentic AI / LLM-based experiences
(including HITL and HOTL patterns) and integrating them into enterprise products.
Experience managing in an AI-augmented engineering environment,
or a genuine enthusiasm and aptitude for adopting AI-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to raise team velocity and quality.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional delivery,
aligning engineering, product, and design stakeholders around shared goals and managing execution with clarity and accountability.
Strong people management skills,
including structured performance management, career development frameworks, and the ability to have direct, compassionate conversations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
comfortable representing the team to senior leadership and working effectively across time zones and cultures.
A high engineering bar:
you understand what great looks like in data quality, pipeline reliability, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and observability, and you hold the team to that standard.

We're Even More Excited If You Have

Experience standing up a new engineering team or office, especially in a greenfield or hub-expansion context where you shaped culture from scratch.
Experience delivering a cloud data-warehouse migration or modernisation (e.g., to Snowflake) and building customer-facing embedded analytics.
Hands-on exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration, or ML-driven decisioning in a production enterprise setting.
Background in regulated industries such as finance, accounting, or fintech, giving you sensitivity to the compliance and reliability requirements our customers depend on - and to the office-of-the-CFO analytics use cases this team serves.
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and experience guiding teams building on Azure (and comfort across AWS or Google Cloud).
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and how to guide a team in applying them responsibly when leveraging AI-generated code and autonomous agents in production.
A history of strong cross-timezone collaboration with engineering and product leadership in distributed organizations.

Total Base Pay Range
336 000,00 - 420 000,00 PLN Annual

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws.

BlackLine recognizes that the ways we work and the workplace itself has shifted. We innovate in a workplace that optimizes a combination of virtual and in-person interactions to maximize collaboration and nurture our culture. Candidates who live within a reasonable commute to one of our offices will work in the office at least 3 days a week.

BlackLine is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation that would better enable your success during the application or interview process, please complete this form.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)
jobs.description:
Pomagamy naszym Klientom definiować ścieżkę transformacji w oparciu o najnowsze technologie – odkrywamy innowacyjne pomysły dzięki analizie danych, tworzymy wyjątkowe doświadczenia dla klientów, wspieramy redukcję kosztów i promujemy nowoczesne, zespołowe podejście do pracy. Dołącz do nas i bądź częścią projektów, które realnie zmieniają sposób działania firm!

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:

Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)

Twoja przyszła rola:

ustanawianie standardów w zakresie projektowania, developmentu, jakości i testów,
projektowanie i komunikowanie architektury systemowej dla rozwiązań enterprise,
projektowanie interoperacyjności i integracji między systemami,
analiza potrzeb, zbieranie wymagań i przekładanie ich na architekturę systemową,
mapowanie celów biznesowych, korzyści projektowych, priorytetów oraz komponentów i funkcji systemowych,
analiza istniejących systemów i identyfikacja możliwych opcji rozwiązania,
utrzymanie i monitorowanie architektury w całym cyklu życia systemu,
szacowanie i estymacja prac developerskich,
udział w projektowaniu systemów, testowaniu, zapewnieniu jakości oraz zarządzaniu zmianą,
przygotowywanie dokumentacji systemowej oraz prowadzenie prezentacji technicznych,
prowadzenie zespołów developerskich i nadzorowanie procesów wytwórczych,
wybór i ocena technologii,
zbieranie i interpretacja metryk systemowych,
optymalizacja systemów pod kątem wydajności, bezpieczeństwa i jakości.

Aplikuj jeśli:

posiadasz co najmniej 2 certyfikaty z obszaru architektury lub inżynierii oprogramowania (np. TOGAF Certified, Certified UML Professional, lub równoważn
pełniłeś/-aś rolę kluczowego architekta w rozwoju min. 2 systemów,
jesteś ekspertem/ekspertką w architekturze systemów i projektowaniu rozwiązań enterprise,
masz doświadczenie w planowaniu wydajności i bezpieczeństwa systemów,
bardzo dobrze znasz technologie: bazy danych, application servers, middleware, web servers, directory services, GIS, bezpieczeństwo na platformach Microsoft, integracje i IDE,
biegle projektujesz w UML,
masz doświadczenie w metodykach RUP, ISO12207 oraz Agile,
swobodnie posługujesz się narzędziami modelującymi: Sparx EA, Aris Architect lub podobnymi,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu dużych systemów w architekturze mikroserwisowej,
masz doświadczenie w budowie large knowledge systems,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu rozwiązań .NET,
pracowałeś/-aś z: Kafka, SQL Server, Redis, OpenShift/Kubernetes, Azure DevOps,
wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
możliwość prowadzenia działalności jako jednoosobowy przedsiębiorca lub podmiot gospodarczy w Polsce (ze względu na projektowy charakter zatrudnienia).

Mile widziane:

doświadczenie w prowadzeniu architektury systemowej w projektach międzynarodowych,
wcześniejsze doświadczenie w roli Lead Architect / Principal Architect,
doświadczenie w optymalizacji systemów pod kątem skalowalności i wysokiej dostępności,
dodatkowe certyfikaty z architektury, chmury lub inżynierii oprogramowania.

Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:

udział w różnorodnych i wymagających projektach, które pozwolą uniknąć rutyny i rozwijać kompetencje doradcze,
hybrydowy model pracy, elastyczne godziny oraz możliwość okazjonalnej pracy zdalnej,
szansę na realizację projektów międzynarodowych oraz sporadyczne wyjazdy służbowe.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?

zaaplikuj,
porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterką,
poznajmy się lepiej podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej!

Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w celu przeprowadzenia rekrutacji jest PwC Advisory sp. z o.o. sp.k., lub inna spółka z sieci PwC (lista spółek), do której kierujesz aplikację. Jeśli wyrazisz odrębną zgodę, dane osobowe będą przetwarzane również w innych celach zgodnie z treścią udzielonych zgód. Pełną informację o przetwarzaniu danych osobowych oraz o przysługujących Ci prawach znajdziesz w Polityce Prywatności.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET / C# + React)
jobs.description:
Lokalizacja:
Polska, zdalnie
Forma współpracy:
B2B
Stawka:
900 - 1100 zł/MD

Dla jednego z naszych klientów poszukujemy Senior Software Engineera
, który przede wszystkim mocno stoi po stronie backendu
, ale jednocześnie potrafi swobodnie poruszać się po frontendzie i przejąć odpowiedzialność za funkcjonalność end-to-end
. To rola dla osoby, która lubi pracować nie tylko nad pojedynczym komponentem, ale rozumie, jak zmiana wpływa na cały system
— od API i logiki biznesowej, przez dane i komunikację asynchroniczną, aż po frontend. Szukamy osoby backend-first
, bardzo mocnej w .NET/C#
, która jednocześnie potrafi wejść w React/TypeScript

It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Tworzymy zespół AI & Agents w Ringier Axel Springer Polska. Budujemy wewnętrzne, produkcyjne platformy klasy enterprise dla ponad 1500 pracowników od infrastruktury AWS, przez backend i współdzielone kontrakty domenowe, aż po frontend.

Jak pracujemy? Kod nie jest już wąskim gardłem. Większość naszej bazy kodu powstaje przy użyciu systemów opartych na agentach programistycznych, działających w oparciu o ludzki projekt i weryfikację. Kluczowe umiejętności to architektura, ocena rozwiązań i orkiestracja: projektujesz system, sterujesz agentami, weryfikujesz zmiany i odpowiadasz za finalny produkt.

Działa to w obie strony agenci funkcjonują również wewnątrz samych produktów.

Chatboty, voiceboty, asystenci oraz systemy klasyfikacji, ekstrakcji danych i podejmowania decyzji usprawniają procesy biznesowe, ograniczając liczbę kliknięć i pracy ręcznej.

Czym się będziesz zajmował/a?

Kompleksową odpowiedzialnością za produkty od wyzwania biznesowego, przez architekturę i wdrożenie, po utrzymanie.
Prowadzeniem inicjatyw, wyznaczaniem kierunku, kwestionowaniem założeń i angażowaniem zespołu.
Kierowaniem pracą coding agents (np. Claude Code) przy zadaniach produkcyjnych dekompozycją problemów, zarządzaniem kontekstem, sterowaniem agentami i weryfikacją wygenerowanych zmian.
Projektowaniem agentic workflows i środowiska pracy agentów (harness) z wykorzystaniem Agent Skills, sub-agents, custom commands i MCP wspierających cały cykl życia produktu: od specyfikacji po wdrożenie i utrzymanie.
Wdrażaniem LLM-ów bezpośrednio w produktach, z wykorzystaniem RAG, pamięci, pipeline’ów, pętli agentowych i mechanizmów ewaluacji, przy zachowaniu odpowiednich guardrails i modelu human-in-the-loop.
Budowaniem end-to-end w monorepo TypeScriptowym: React, Node.js/Express, Zod, XState, Drizzle, Terraform/Terragrunt i GitHub Actions, na AWS (Lambda, SQS, ECS/Fargate, Aurora, S3).
Integracją z Entra ID, Teams, Azure OpenAI, SAP i Copilot Studio oraz współpracą bezpośrednio z biznesem i użytkownikami.

Czego oczekujemy?

Solidnego doświadczenia z React/TypeScript i Node.js oraz projektowania i wdrażania produkcyjnych systemów end-to-end.
Znajomości nowoczesnej architektury webowej: SPA, CDN, caching, usługi warstwowe, streaming, WebSockets.
Codziennego, praktycznego doświadczenia z coding agents (np. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) przy pracy z produkcyjnym kodem.
Znajomości praktyk agentic engineering: specyfikacje i plany, agentic workflow, praca równoległa, MCP, integracja z CI/CD oraz świadome zarządzanie ograniczeniami agentów.
Doświadczenia w budowaniu AI/LLM jako części logiki biznesowej produktu, a nie tylko dodatkowego interfejsu chatowego w tym RAG, pipelines, agent loops, ewaluacje i pamięć.
Dużej samodzielności potrafisz przeprowadzić problem od niejasnego wymagania do gotowego produktu.
Praktycznego doświadczenia z AWS i nastawienia produktowego.

Mile Widziane

Znajomość technologii: XState, Drizzle; Copilot Studio / Power Platform; Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams oraz Adaptive Cards.

Jak pracujemy? Kod nie jest już wąskim gardłem. Większość naszej bazy kodu powstaje przy użyciu systemów opartych na agentach programistycznych, działających w oparciu o ludzki projekt i weryfikację. Kluczowe umiejętności to architektura, ocena rozwiązań i orkiestracja: projektujesz system, sterujesz agentami, weryfikujesz zmiany i odpowiadasz za finalny produkt.

Działa to w obie strony agenci funkcjonują również wewnątrz samych produktów.

Chatboty, voiceboty, asystenci oraz systemy klasyfikacji, ekstrakcji danych i podejmowania decyzji usprawniają procesy biznesowe, ograniczając liczbę kliknięć i pracy ręcznej.

Czym się będziesz zajmował/a?

Kompleksową odpowiedzialnością za produkty od wyzwania biznesowego, przez architekturę i wdrożenie, po utrzymanie.
Prowadzeniem inicjatyw, wyznaczaniem kierunku, kwestionowaniem założeń i angażowaniem zespołu.
Kierowaniem pracą coding agents (np. Claude Code) przy zadaniach produkcyjnych dekompozycją problemów, zarządzaniem kontekstem, sterowaniem agentami i weryfikacją wygenerowanych zmian.
Projektowaniem agentic workflows i środowiska pracy agentów (harness) z wykorzystaniem Agent Skills, sub-agents, custom commands i MCP wspierających cały cykl życia produktu: od specyfikacji po wdrożenie i utrzymanie.
Wdrażaniem LLM-ów bezpośrednio w produktach, z wykorzystaniem RAG, pamięci, pipeline’ów, pętli agentowych i mechanizmów ewaluacji, przy zachowaniu odpowiednich guardrails i modelu human-in-the-loop.
Budowaniem end-to-end w monorepo TypeScriptowym: React, Node.js/Express, Zod, XState, Drizzle, Terraform/Terragrunt i GitHub Actions, na AWS (Lambda, SQS, ECS/Fargate, Aurora, S3).
Integracją z Entra ID, Teams, Azure OpenAI, SAP i Copilot Studio oraz współpracą bezpośrednio z biznesem i użytkownikami.

Czego oczekujemy?

Solidnego doświadczenia z React/TypeScript i Node.js oraz projektowania i wdrażania produkcyjnych systemów end-to-end.
Znajomości nowoczesnej architektury webowej: SPA, CDN, caching, usługi warstwowe, streaming, WebSockets.
Codziennego, praktycznego doświadczenia z coding agents (np. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) przy pracy z produkcyjnym kodem.
Znajomości praktyk agentic engineering: specyfikacje i plany, agentic workflow, praca równoległa, MCP, integracja z CI/CD oraz świadome zarządzanie ograniczeniami agentów.
Doświadczenia w budowaniu AI/LLM jako części logiki biznesowej produktu, a nie tylko dodatkowego interfejsu chatowego w tym RAG, pipelines, agent loops, ewaluacje i pamięć.
Dużej samodzielności potrafisz przeprowadzić problem od niejasnego wymagania do gotowego produktu.
Praktycznego doświadczenia z AWS i nastawienia produktowego.

Mile Widziane

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5— Platform Modernization Engineering
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Team

The Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) — Migrations team exists to accelerate Netflix's ability to evolve its infrastructure by driving safe, scalable migrations across the stack. We reduce engineering toil, eliminate technical debt, and enable teams to move forward with confidence as Netflix's technology continues to evolve at pace.

We are not a feature delivery team. We are a revenue protector and accelerator — through our work we enable faster feature delivery, innovation, and security protection across the entire engineering organization.

Netflix operates one of the most sophisticated and high-scale engineering platforms in the world. Keeping that platform on the leading edge requires continuous, intentional modernization. The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering

Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling

Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design

Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy

Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence

Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Required Experience

Strong backend engineering skills, with demonstrated ability to build and operate production services at scale (experience in Java or Python is a plus)
Proven experience navigating and operating within large, complex infrastructure ecosystems — understanding service interdependencies, fleet-wide patterns, and the ripple effects of change at scale
Deep, hands-on experience with AI-driven solutions — not as a user, but as a builder. You follow where the technology is going, form opinions, and bring that edge into the work
Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion
Strong technical writing: design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems
Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes)
Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders

Experience We'd Be Excited About

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns
Demonstrated ability to build with or integrate LLMs and AI agents into engineering workflows — you have shipped AI-powered solutions, not just experimented with them
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context
Experience designing campaigns with measurable adoption and adherence metricsa

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Platform team, where you will help build the cloud-native backbone that powers Relativity’s development ecosystem. You will work on high-impact initiatives that shape how our engineers build, test, deploy, and scale software—driving technical excellence across the company.

As part of a growing and financially stable organization, you will contribute in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that values autonomy, ownership, and practical action over excessive process. Platform engineers are trusted to solve complex problems at scale and empowered to make decisions that improve the day-to-day experience of developers.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable platform services and developer tooling using .NET and Microsoft Azure
Lead the development of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) components to automate and standardize cloud infrastructure
Drive adoption of DevOps practices and CI/CD automation across engineering teams
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to build reusable capabilities that improve development speed and consistency
Integrate observability, performance monitoring, and self-service tooling into the platform ecosystem
Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing
Proactively identify improvement areas, experiment with solutions, and deliver results with a bias toward action
Contribute to initiatives that embed AI/ML into platform services and developer workflows

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem
Deep hands-on experience with Azure services and cloud-native application patterns
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
Experience building or supporting CI/CD systems and modern DevOps pipelines

jobs.title: Copilot Studio Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Katowice/Wrocław/Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Architect
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design and deliver end-to-end agentic AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform
Build scalable, secure architectures with strong focus on enterprise readiness
Develop advanced integrations with systems like SAP using APIs, custom connectors, and Azure services
Implement identity & access management patterns, including principal propagation (ensuring agents correctly inherit user permissions across systems)
Define how agents are authenticated and authorized when accessing external systems (e.g., retrieving invoice data or status from SAP)
Work hands-on with pro-code extensions (Microsoft AI stack, agent frameworks) for complex scenarios
Lead client engagements: shape vision, design solutions, run workshops, and present architectures
Support pre-sales activities (demos, PoCs, proposals) and contribute to AI/automation offerings

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and agentic AI solutions
Solid background in integration design (REST APIs, OAuth, identity propagation patterns)
Strong experience with Power Platform architecture (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and managed identities
Ability to design complex solutions independently and clearly communicate them to stakeholders
Strong consulting and problem-solving mindset

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience integrating Copilot Studio / Power Platform with SAP
Experience working with Agent365 or at least thorough understanding of capabilities and implementation best practices
Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, AutoGen)
Pro-code development skills (.NET, C#, JavaScript)
Experience with custom connectors and API management

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.

In compliance with the requirements of the Whistleblower Protection Act, our company has established the Procedure for reporting breaches of law and undertaking appropriate follow-up actions . Any misconduct should be reported through the EY Ethics Hotline.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)
jobs.description:
Pomagamy naszym Klientom definiować ścieżkę transformacji w oparciu o najnowsze technologie – odkrywamy innowacyjne pomysły dzięki analizie danych, tworzymy wyjątkowe doświadczenia dla klientów, wspieramy redukcję kosztów i promujemy nowoczesne, zespołowe podejście do pracy. Dołącz do nas i bądź częścią projektów, które realnie zmieniają sposób działania firm!

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:

Solutions Architect (rola projektowa)

Twoja przyszła rola:

ustanawianie standardów w zakresie projektowania, developmentu, jakości i testów,
projektowanie i komunikowanie architektury systemowej dla rozwiązań enterprise,
projektowanie interoperacyjności i integracji między systemami,
analiza potrzeb, zbieranie wymagań i przekładanie ich na architekturę systemową,
mapowanie celów biznesowych, korzyści projektowych, priorytetów oraz komponentów i funkcji systemowych,
analiza istniejących systemów i identyfikacja możliwych opcji rozwiązania,
utrzymanie i monitorowanie architektury w całym cyklu życia systemu,
szacowanie i estymacja prac developerskich,
udział w projektowaniu systemów, testowaniu, zapewnieniu jakości oraz zarządzaniu zmianą,
przygotowywanie dokumentacji systemowej oraz prowadzenie prezentacji technicznych,
prowadzenie zespołów developerskich i nadzorowanie procesów wytwórczych,
wybór i ocena technologii,
zbieranie i interpretacja metryk systemowych,
optymalizacja systemów pod kątem wydajności, bezpieczeństwa i jakości.

Aplikuj jeśli:

posiadasz co najmniej 2 certyfikaty z obszaru architektury lub inżynierii oprogramowania (np. TOGAF Certified, Certified UML Professional, lub równoważn
pełniłeś/-aś rolę kluczowego architekta w rozwoju min. 2 systemów,
jesteś ekspertem/ekspertką w architekturze systemów i projektowaniu rozwiązań enterprise,
masz doświadczenie w planowaniu wydajności i bezpieczeństwa systemów,
bardzo dobrze znasz technologie: bazy danych, application servers, middleware, web servers, directory services, GIS, bezpieczeństwo na platformach Microsoft, integracje i IDE,
biegle projektujesz w UML,
masz doświadczenie w metodykach RUP, ISO12207 oraz Agile,
swobodnie posługujesz się narzędziami modelującymi: Sparx EA, Aris Architect lub podobnymi,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu dużych systemów w architekturze mikroserwisowej,
masz doświadczenie w budowie large knowledge systems,
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu rozwiązań .NET,
pracowałeś/-aś z: Kafka, SQL Server, Redis, OpenShift/Kubernetes, Azure DevOps,
wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
możliwość prowadzenia działalności jako jednoosobowy przedsiębiorca lub podmiot gospodarczy w Polsce (ze względu na projektowy charakter zatrudnienia).

Mile widziane:

doświadczenie w prowadzeniu architektury systemowej w projektach międzynarodowych,
wcześniejsze doświadczenie w roli Lead Architect / Principal Architect,
doświadczenie w optymalizacji systemów pod kątem skalowalności i wysokiej dostępności,
dodatkowe certyfikaty z architektury, chmury lub inżynierii oprogramowania.

Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:

udział w różnorodnych i wymagających projektach, które pozwolą uniknąć rutyny i rozwijać kompetencje doradcze,
hybrydowy model pracy, elastyczne godziny oraz możliwość okazjonalnej pracy zdalnej,
szansę na realizację projektów międzynarodowych oraz sporadyczne wyjazdy służbowe.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?

zaaplikuj,
porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterką,
poznajmy się lepiej podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej!

Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w celu przeprowadzenia rekrutacji jest PwC Advisory sp. z o.o. sp.k., lub inna spółka z sieci PwC (lista spółek), do której kierujesz aplikację. Jeśli wyrazisz odrębną zgodę, dane osobowe będą przetwarzane również w innych celach zgodnie z treścią udzielonych zgód. Pełną informację o przetwarzaniu danych osobowych oraz o przysługujących Ci prawach znajdziesz w Polityce Prywatności.

jobs.description:
Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

🏠 Hybrid work (3 days/week from the office)

💰Copyrights which means higher net salary for Developers
🌐 Fully remote recruitment process
🖋 Stable employment based on an employment contract
LuxMed health & dental care
🏦 Life insurance, 🧳 Travel insurance
🏋🏽 MyBenefit program (sports card, well-being program etc.)
📞Employee assistance program for you and your family! (consultations with a psychologist, coaching sessions, assistance in private life)

Som Senior .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i Skandias AML-team (Anti-Money Laundering), där ni utvecklar systemstöd för att förebygga penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism – ett affärskritiskt uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Vi söker dig som trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabila lösningar är avgörande. Du är van att arbeta i affärskritiska systemmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och implementation till vidareutveckling och förbättring.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.

Du har även ett intresse för att ligga i framkant inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, till exempel genom verktyg som GitHub Copilot.

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Du kan läsa mer om vår process här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stephan Mannerfelt på stephan.mannerfelt@skandia.se

Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Madelene Skogh, på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team inom delprojektet Digital Map Generating System (DMGS) / Geodata inom JAS Gripen i rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare.

Vi är en central resurs som har expertis inom GIS, geodata och aeronautisk information. Geodata är en viktig del av de flesta av Saabs produkter och tjänster inom flyg, försvar och säkerhet. I rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare ingår t.ex. uppgifter som att arbeta fram kreativa lösningar kring överenskommen kravbild tillsammans med angränsande system. Planering, testning och möjligheten att kommunicera utvecklad funktion till intressenter kan också vara en del av arbetet.

Det finns en stor möjlighet till att anpassa dagarna med varierade arbetsuppgifter och även möjligheter att få delta på konferenser som sker utomlands.

Din närmsta chef är utbildad coach och om du brinner för personlig utveckling finns det stora möjligheter. Du erbjuds möjligheten att genomföra både interna och externa utbildningar.

Förmågan att säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Inkluderar även testning, säkerhet och prestandaoptimering.
Förmågan att arbeta effektivt i ett team och har en bra kommunikativ approach

As a .NET Developer, you'll join an agile team responsible for some of SEB's most business-critical payment reporting solutions. Our applications support high payment volumes and provide essential reporting capabilities across the bank.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of established banking systems and modern technology. You'll help modernize and evolve our payment reporting platforms while ensuring the stability, reliability, and performance expected from critical financial infrastructure.

You'll work across a diverse technology landscape that includes .NET, SQL Server, SEB's container platform, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Together, we are transforming how reporting solutions are built and operated, enabling faster delivery, increased scalability, and improved customer value.

In this role, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain business-critical payment reporting solutions

Work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and fellow developers to deliver high-quality solutions
Optimize application performance and database workloads
Take ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle, from development to production

Strong development experience in .NET, C#, and preferably VB.NET
Experience working with high-volume, business-critical applications
Strong SQL skills, including performance tuning and query optimization
A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving
The ability to work independently and take ownership of your deliveries

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Nu söker vi på Synsam en Backend Developer som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår digitala plattform och skapa stabila lösningar som gör skillnad för både verksamheten och våra kunder. Vi söker dig som tar stort eget ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och gärna bidrar med initiativ, kunskap och idéer som utvecklar både våra lösningar och vårt sätt att arbeta.
Hos oss blir du en viktig del av Synsams fortsatta digitala utveckling och vår ambition att vara det ledande och mest hållbara livsstilsföretaget inom optik och ögonhälsa. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar i en miljö där innovation, utveckling och en riktigt bra digital kundupplevelse står i fokus. Är du nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att bygga smarta och hållbara lösningar? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

Om tjänsten

Som Backend Developer blir du en del av vårt Digital Business-team, där du tillsammans med Team Lead och kollegor inom fullstack, backend, frontend och test driver utvecklingen av Synsams e-handelsplattform. Du arbetar med .NET, C# och Visual Basic och är med och vidareutvecklar stabila lösningar som är en viktig del av våra kunders digitala upplevelse.
Hos oss är ensam inte stark! Du blir en del av ett framåtsträvande och sammansvetsat tvärfunktionellt team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och lär av varandra. Din närmaste chef, Pasha Ayani, arbetar även som Team Lead och tillsammans med resten av teamet driver ni utvecklingen framåt. Det här är ett team som välkomnar nya idéer, vågar testa alternativa vägar och tillsammans hittar lösningar som skapar värde för både Synsam och våra kunder.

Ditt arbete kommer bland annat innebära:

Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara backend-lösningar.
Implementera och förvalta integrationer mot externa system.
Delta i teknisk planering och scoping av initiativ.
Säkerställa prestanda, säkerhet och stabilitet i våra tjänster.
Sätta och upprätthålla kodstandarder, samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar i teamets arbetsmetoder.
Stötta teamet vid komplexa tekniska utmaningar.
Utforska och implementera nya teknologier och verktyg för att förbättra våra processer.

Profil

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren backendutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa komplexa problem och bygga stabila och skalbara lösningar. Du är tekniskt nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och fokus på att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
Du trivs i ett prestigelöst och tvärfunktionellt team där man samarbetar nära och gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke-tekniska kollegor och bidrar gärna till att utveckla såväl våra tekniska lösningar som teamets arbetssätt.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av backend-utveckling.
Stark kunskap inom .NET och C#.
Erfarenhet av databaser, databasdesign och optimering i MSSQL.
Erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure, samt CI/CD.
Vana av agila arbetsmetoder och att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team.
Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande:
Erfarenhet av frontend, eventbaserad design och API-integrationer.

Några ord från Pasha Ayani, Team Lead.

"Det bästa med att arbeta på Synsam är kombinationen av modern teknik, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en del av ett kompetent och prestigelöst team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och tillsammans utvecklar den digitala kundupplevelsen. När jag inte jobbar tränar jag brasiliansk jiu-jitsu, lagar mat och umgås med familj och vänner, en bra balans som jag tycker är viktig även i arbetslivet."

Har vi väckt ditt intresse?

Vad roligt! Klicka på länken nedan och skicka in din ansökan redan idag! I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team!🌟

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a mid-level full-stack developer with a strong sense of ownership and genuine curiosity. You will work across a suite of applications built primarily with .NET, running in Docker-based environments. That means taking features from start to finish, contributing to architectural decisions, and helping improve how the team works.

Day to day, that means building and maintaining backend services in C#, developing front-end components in TypeScript, designing REST APIs, and operating services with Docker and Docker Compose. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation and internal tooling as the need arises.

We are AI-first in practice, not just in name. We actively use AI-assisted development workflows and expect that to deepen over time. The landscape shifts fast, and we are not waiting to see where it lands. We are building with it now. That means we want someone who is genuinely curious about these tools, experiments with them, and develops their own judgment about when and how to use them well.

Why Maranics

Most people spend years executing other people's decisions. At Maranics, you own the outcome. We are a small team building a tool that changes how businesses run in practice. Not prototypes, not internal tools that get quietly abandoned. When something ships here, you feel it.

Because we are small, your work is visible and the people who depend on it are not three teams away. We are genuinely AI-first, and we are building the kind of team that develops real judgment on real problems. Growth here is not rationed. When you are ready for more, you take it.

What We Are Looking For

You have 2–4 years of professional software development experience, solid .NET backend skills, and practical front-end experience. You are comfortable with Docker, Git-based workflows, and taking full ownership of a feature. A good grasp of software architecture fundamentals is important, as is strong written and spoken English.

Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or AI-assisted development tools is a plus. So is having worked in a small, distributed team before. You will know what that feels like.

Who This Is For

This role suits someone who wants more than ticket execution, who notices things, communicates openly, and cares about the outcome. If you want to build real things in a small remote team where your work has visible impact and your name is attached to it, this role will fit.

Practical Information

Location: Maranics is based in Gothenburg and the role works well hybrid, with flexibility on how often you are in the office.
Work permit within EU is required.
Start: As soon as possible, with consideration for your notice period.

About Maranics

Maranics builds a platform that digitalises operational workflows in complex, regulated industries. Where data was previously lost, scattered across silos, or trapped in manual processes, Maranics creates a single connected layer capturing what matters, routing it in real time, and delivering accurate, contextual data directly to the systems that need it.

jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineering Consultant (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
AI förändrar inte bara hur vi skriver kod. Det förändrar hur system designas, hur team arbetar och vilka kompetenser som kommer att särskilja morgondagens ingenjörer.

För utvecklare som vill fortsätta utvecklas räcker det inte längre att enbart behärska programmering. Det krävs också förståelse för arkitektur, systemdesign och hur AI kan användas som en integrerad del av utvecklingsarbetet.

Din resa som konsult hos SALT börjar med en fem veckor lång accelerator där du bygger den engineering- och AI-kompetens som marknaden efterfrågar idag – och som kommer att bli ännu viktigare imorgon. Därefter matchas du med en av våra kunder, där du får omsätta dina nya kunskaper i praktiken som konsult.

Din konsultkarriär hos SALT

Som konsult hos SALT blir du en del av ett nätverk av utvecklare och ingenjörer som arbetar hos ledande företag inom bland annat fintech, retail, telekom och industri. Vårt kommersiella team, med över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen, matchar dig med uppdrag där du får fortsätta utvecklas inom modern software engineering, AI och systemdesign. Vår ambition är att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna att ligga i framkant, även när tekniken förändras.

SALT är inte ett traditionellt konsultbolag. Vi är i grunden ett utbildningsbolag och hos oss slutar inte kompetensutvecklingen när du börjar ditt första uppdrag. Genom vår etablerade utbildningsverksamhet, coachning och SALT Community fortsätter du att bygga din kompetens tillsammans med andra konsulter och alumner. Vårt kontor är beläget centralt på Medborgarplatsen och arbetskulturen präglas av en stark gemenskap och att ständigt hjälpa varandra att utvecklas. Vi har regelbundna AW:s och interna event där du har möjlighet att träffa kollegor och bygga ditt nätverk även mellan uppdragen.

Om acceleratorn

Acceleratorn är en del av din väg in i konsultrollen och är utvecklad för dig som redan behärskar grunderna i programmering. Under fem intensiva heltidsveckor får du möjlighet att höja din tekniska nivå och bygga kompetens inom områden som blir allt viktigare i framtidens ingenjörsroller – från systemdesign och arkitektur till AI och avancerade engineering practices.

Du arbetar tillsammans med andra utvecklare i projekt och teammiljöer som speglar moderna utvecklingsorganisationer. Fokus ligger på att utveckla ditt engineering thinking, din förmåga att fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut och att arbeta AI-native genom hela utvecklingsprocessen.

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

AI-assisterad utveckling och moderna AI-verktyg
Systemdesign och mjukvaruarkitektur
Engineering trade-offs och tekniskt beslutsfattande
Skalbara system och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer
Kodgranskning och teknisk kommunikation
Teambaserad problemlösning
Avancerade utvecklingsprojekt

De sista två veckorna ägnas åt ett större projekt där du omsätter dina kunskaper i praktiken och bygger en lösning som demonstrerar både teknisk bredd, systemförståelse och förmågan att arbeta som en modern, AI-native engineer.

Praktisk information

Din anställning hos SALT börjar med en fem veckor lång accelerator på heltid från vårt kontor i Stockholm.

Efter godkänd accelerator matchas du mot uppdrag hos någon av våra kunder. Målet är att du ska kliva in i ditt första uppdrag med en stärkt engineering-profil, djupare teknisk förståelse och förmågan att arbeta som en AI-native developer.

Du lär dig att:

Använda AI som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen, från design och implementation till testning, kvalitetssäkring och dokumentation.
Höja din kompetensnivå kring systemdesign, arkitektur och tekniska vägval utifrån verkliga affärs- och systemkrav.
Utvärdera, förbättra och kvalitetssäkra AI-genererade lösningar.
Kommunicera tekniska beslut och samarbeta effektivt med både utvecklare och andra roller i organisationen.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi söker dig som redan arbetat ett par år i utvecklarrollen och nu vill investera i nästa fas av din karriär.

Du behöver:

Ha minst 2–3 års erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling.
Ha erfarenhet av utveckling i C#/.NET eller Java, där C#/.NET är vårt primära teknikområde under acceleratorn.
Ha arbetat med versionshantering och samarbete i utvecklingsteam.
Ha god förståelse för objektorienterad programmering och grundläggande designprinciper.
Vara flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige.
Vara permanent bosatt i eller i närheten av Stockholm.

Det är meriterande om du:

Har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS.
Har arbetat med arkitektur- eller systemdesignfrågor.
Har använt AI-verktyg som en del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.
Har experimenterat med agentiska arbetsflöden eller AI-drivna processer.
Har erfarenhet av kodgranskning, mentorskap eller tekniskt ledarskap.

Som person ser vi att du:

Gillar att förstå hur saker hänger ihop, inte bara få dem att fungera.
Är nyfiken på hur software engineering förändras och vill ligga steget före.
Trivs i miljöer där lärande och kunskapsdelning är en del av vardagen.
Har lätt för att samarbeta, ge och ta feedback samt bidra till teamets utveckling.
Ser AI som en naturlig del av framtidens software engineering och är motiverad att utveckla nya arbetssätt där AI förstärker både den egna och teamets förmåga att skapa värde.

Övrig information

Start:
4 januari 2027

Plats:
Medborgarplatsen, Stockholm

Sista ansökningsdag:
30 september 2026

Ta första steget mot din nya karriär och skicka in din ansökan redan idag — vi tillämpar löpande urval.

SALT är stolt över att vara en jämlik arbetsgivare som välkomnar individer av alla kön, bakgrunder och erfarenheter. Bli en del av ett företag i teknikens framkant som värdesätter och främjar stor mångfald på arbetsplatsen. Kulturen på SALT kännetecknas av att vara inkluderande, öppen och dynamisk.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?
At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We're looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C# and React/TypeScript. You'll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.
We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.
At Appgate, you'll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.
At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.
Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We're also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.
We're also developing AI-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

Requirements

Your role in the Core team

The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.
The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.
This is a fullstack role:
your work will span the client, its C# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You'll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate | Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.
You'll help us:

• Develop features for the Appgate client, using C#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
• Develop features for the Java REST backend.
• Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
• Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
• Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.
What you bring

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You're comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.
We're looking for:

• Strong professional experience with C#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.
• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.
• Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

Build something, you can put your name to If you're looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Appgate's Core team and help shape what comes next.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
