jobs.title: Software & AI Engineering Program (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
Vill du bygga en karriär som mjukvaruingenjör med kompetens i framkant – där du både behärskar kodhantverket och skapar förutsättningar för att orkestrera AI‑drivna system?

AI har redan blivit en del av infrastrukturen i mjukvaruutveckling. Det handlar inte längre bara om att skriva kod, utan om att förstå hur system hänger ihop, hur AI kan förstärka ditt arbete och hur du skapar verkligt värde i team. Samtidigt är grunderna fortsatt avgörande.

Under det här programmet bygger du en stabil grund som fullstack‑utvecklare, samtidigt som du utvecklar den AI‑, system- och ingenjörsförståelse som behövs för att kunna ta dig an roller inom AI‑orkestrering.

Om programmet

Programmet är intensivt och pågår under tre månader på plats på vårt kontor i Stockholm.

Upplägget är designat för att du ska kunna ta dig an framtidens ingenjörsroller. Först a
delen fokuserar du på att stärka ditt kodhantverk och din förståelse för moderna fullstack‑miljöer. Du skriver mycket kod, jobbar med testning, versionshantering och mobbprogrammering, och lär dig hur en professionell utvecklingsprocess ser ut i praktiken. Därefter lyfter du blicken
: du arbetar mer med arkitektur, systemdesign och AI. Du lär dig hur du använder AI‑verktyg för att designa, producera, testa och skala kod – och hur agentiska arbetssätt och orkestrering kan se ut i verkliga team.

Resultatet är att du både kommer kunna gå in i juniora utvecklarroller, men också ta dig an roller där du förväntas vara mer drivande i hur AI används i teamet och organisationen – som en AI‑orkestratör med stark grund i utveckling.

Efter avslutat program matchar vårt säljteam dig med ett konsultuppdrag hos någon av våra kunder, med målsättningen att det leder till en fast anställning.

Du lär dig att:

Bygga upp ett stabilt fundament i modern fullstack‑utveckling: skriva kod, testa, felsöka, samarbeta i versionshantering och arbeta i agila team.
Använda AI‑verktyg som en naturlig del av ditt dagliga arbetsflöde – både för att skriva, förbättra och kvalitetssäkra kod – samtidigt som du tränar din förmåga att granska, ifrågasätta och förbättra AI:ns förslag.
Tänka i system snarare än isolerade funktioner: förstå hur komponenter hänger ihop, varför vissa arkitekturbeslut fattas och vilka trade‑offs som görs.
Ta de första stegen mot AI‑orkestrering: designa agentiska arbetsflöden, kombinera flera verktyg och resonera kring hur AI kan förstärka ett team snarare än ersätta det.
Arbeta i team där kodgranskning, kunskapsdelning, mentorskap och kontinuerligt lärande är en del av vardagen – och där du förväntas bidra både tekniskt och kommunikativt.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi söker dig som har lagt grunden själv, men vill ta nästa steg tillsammans med erfarna instruktörer.

Du behöver:

Ha programmerat regelbundet det senaste året (t.ex. egna projekt, frilans, studier eller open source) – helst med fokus på att bygga något lite större.
Ha erfarenhet av något eller några språk såsom Java, JavaScript, C#, Python eller liknande.
Ha en avslutad eftergymnasial utbildning.
Ha relevant eller närliggande arbetslivserfarenhet där du samarbetat i en teammiljö.
Vara flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
Ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige.
Vara permanent bosatt i eller i närheten av Stockholm.

Det är meriterande om du:

Har jobbat med AI‑verktyg i ditt eget lärande eller utvecklingsarbete, t.ex. för att förstå kod, förbättra struktur, skriva tester eller utforska nya lösningar.
Har börjat experimentera med agentiska upplägg (t.ex. kedjor av verktyg, automatiserade flöden eller enklare agent‑system) eller är nyfiken på hur sådana kan byggas.
Har kunskap i objektorienterad programmering och grundläggande systemdesign.
Har en kandidat- eller masterexamen

Som person letar vi efter dig som:

Gillar att förstå hur saker hänger ihop, inte bara få något att “funka”.
Är nyfiken, proaktiv och trivs i miljöer där mycket förändras.
Tycker om att kommunicera med olika människor och roller inom en organisation.
Har lätt för att samarbeta, ge och ta feedback samt tycker det är kul att lära tillsammans med andra

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Digital Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Do you want to turn digital designs into real-world manufacturing solutions and help shape the future of production? At Sandvik Coromant in Gimo, you’re part of building smarter, more automated and data-driven manufacturing environments.

Why Sandvik?

At Sandvik Coromant, you join a market-leading company where innovation, sustainability and development are at the core of everything we do. Here, you get to:

Work with cutting-edge technology in a highly automated production environment
Collaborate globally in a diverse and inclusive organization
Contribute to solutions that shape the future of manufacturing

About The Job

You develop innovative and scalable software solutions that bridge digital design and physical manufacturing. Working closely with global teams, you enable smarter and more efficient production through automation and advanced data-driven approaches.

Job Responsibilities

Develop automation solutions that support the journey toward lights-out production
Translate product requirements into actionable shop floor solutions
Contribute to methodologies for robust and state-of-the-art software solutions
Support CAD automation using internal domain-specific languages
Create seamless automation flows from design to production
Participate in local and global projects related to new technologies and products

Location

This position is based on-site in Gimo, Sweden.

Your profile

You have a strong foundation in engineering and programming, combined with an interest in manufacturing and industrial processes. Working in a global environment, you communicate effectively in both English and Swedish and enjoy collaborating across teams and disciplines.

Your background includes:

Experience in programming (e.g. Python, Java, C#)
Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing or industrial processes
Familiarity with areas such as CAD/CAM, product development or automation
Understanding of modern development practices, such as agile methodologies
Experience working with systems, architecture or data-driven solutions
K8s and Microservices architecture and development practices

You’re curious and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset that drives continuous improvement. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy working across teams and cultures to turn complex ideas into practical solutions. With a proactive approach, you adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute to a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Curious about Sandvik Coromant in Gimo?

Sandvik Coromant in Gimo is a great place to work, just a short trip from cities like Uppsala, Stockholm and Gävle. Our production site is awarded for its high grade of automation, digitalization and sustainability. We’re also a market-leading manufacturer of products for metal cutting, and in Gimo, we employ around 1200 brilliant minds. Development is in our DNA and we’re proud to create solutions that truly shape the future of manufacturing.

We believe that diversity of experience, perspective, and background leads to a better environment for our employees, our business, and our customers. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

Contact information

Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Björn Molin, hiring manager, bjorn.molin@sandvik.com.

We have already decided on what advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts.

How To Apply

Send your application no later than September 29, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0093317.

We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

Sandvik Coromant is part of the global industrial engineering group Sandvik and is at the forefront of developing manufacturing tools and machining solutions, with knowledge that drives the industry standards and innovations demanded by the metalworking industry now and in the next industrial era. Collaborations with educational institutions, extensive investment in research and development and strong customer partnership ensure the development of machining technologies that change, lead and drive the future of manufacturing. Sandvik Coromant owns over 1700 patents worldwide, employs around 8000 staff and is represented in more than 150 countries.

jobs.title: Power Platform Konsult
jobs.description:
Du sitter i ett projektmöte.

Kunden beskriver ett problem som egentligen inte har någon självklar lösning. Det är komplext, kanske lite rörigt och exakt den typen av utmaning du gillar.

Du börjar ställa frågor, koppla ihop saker, skissa på lösningar i huvudet och du vet att du inte behöver ha alla svar själv. Du har nämligen ett team bakom dig som tänker lika mycket som du och kompletterar dig i det du inte kan.

Det är så det är att jobba på Compago.

Vi bryr oss inte om din debiteringsgrad. Vi tänker inte börja mäta den heller.

Och vi tror inte på lönemodeller som stressar mer än de motiverar. Vi tror istället på balans, trygghet och att faktiskt ha ett hållbart arbetsliv (ja, på riktigt).

Det vi gillar? Kluriga projekt, samarbete och att lösa svåra problem tillsammans. Du är personen som vet att du inte kan allt, men som är rejält nyfiken på att lära dig mer och gärna delar med dig längs vägen.

Hos oss samarbetar vi i projektform åt stora bolag som gör skillnad. Du får grotta ner dig i Power Platform och andra Microsoft-tekniker, förstå kundens verksamhet och bygga smarta lösningar, som förmodligen inte gjorts tidigare och som faktiskt används.

Vi jobbar med allt från SharePoint, Teams och Power BI till Copilot, Azure och Business Central. Kan du inte allt redan? Perfekt, då har du ju massor att lära dig hos oss.

Vem är du?

Om du kommer från kundsidan eller konsult spelar ingen roll. Du trivs med att jobba i projektform, har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft-utveckling och en god förståelse för verksamhet. Att agera arkitekt är något du gillar och du är bekväm i dialogen med kunder. Samtidigt har du lite svårt att hålla dig borta från att koda då och då. Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska, såväl tal som skrift.

För att ge dig bästa möjliga förutsättningar ser vi att du:

Är välbekant med Power Platform/Model Driven Apps ELLER Dynamics CE
Är bekväm med Azure och datamodellering/dataverse

På Compago arbetar vi med placering i centrala Malmö eller Göteborg.

Läs mer om oss och vår rekryteringsprocess.

Ansökan och frågor:

Har du frågor eller funderingar får du gärna höra av dig till Alexander Lindgren och Hanna Elfving på rekrytering@compago.se. Enligt GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl utan de sker enbart via den här annonsen. Du kan läsa mer om vår integritetspolicy här

Ha roligt, utvecklas och bygga starka samarbeten med kollegor och kunder.

Är ingenjör med 8+ års erfarenhet.
Pratar flytande svenska och engelska.
God kommunikationsförmåga, initiativtagande, självständig men samarbetsorienterad.
Är van att jobba nära både teknik och verksamhet.

Bred teknisk kompetens med tyngd mot backend och avancerad problemlösning.

Vi är kräsna med teknikval och uppdrag.

Fokus på långsiktighet, kvalitet och rimliga förväntningar.

Perfekt. Hör av dig så tar vi en kaffe eller ett första samtal.

We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. feel
your work.

As a Agentic ERP Solution Engineering, you will be a core member of the Financial Systems team that owns the systems running Epidemic Sound's financial backbone. Your role is to translate complex financial and operational business needs into scalable technical solutions, working across our ERP ecosystem with a focus on process design, solution architecture, and agentic ways of working.

You will work at the intersection of Tech and Finance, where your ability to understand both business intent and technical possibility directly affects how reliably we run financial operations and scale as a company. You will collaborate closely with engineers across the Tech organisation, the Finance team, and various stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, streamline processes, and leverage the full capabilities of Netsuite to support our long-term growth.

Your key responsibilities include

Translate complex Finance, Procurement, and operational business requirements into scalable, end-to-end ERP solutions, from discovery through to deployment.
Design, build, and maintain robust solutions within our ERP tech stack (centered on NetSuite), including integrations with connected systems and external platforms.
Design and implement agentic workflows and AI-driven automation to streamline financial processes, identifying and evaluating new tools to drive efficiency and accuracy.
Proactively surface process inefficiencies and data integrity issues through AI-assisted analysis, continuously optimizing for long-term scalability.
Act as a technical subject matter expert, communicating directly with stakeholders to translate business intent into technical execution and driving cross-functional initiatives.

Requirements

Solid experience working with ERP platforms, including strong NetSuite configuration and integrations, alongside deep understanding of financial processes like procure-to-pay and order-to-cash.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, scalable, and high-impact technical solutions across complex environments.
Genuine curiosity about and practical experience applying AI and agentic tools in a business context, balancing automation leverage with human judgment.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to partner directly with Finance and Tech teams to drive initiatives while operating as a senior individual contributor.
Act as a technical subject matter expert, partnering with stakeholders and engineering teams to solve complex problems, improve data integrity, and drive cross-functional initiatives.
Strong project leadership and stakeholder communication, with a track record of driving initiatives from discovery to measurable business impact and translating between business intent and technical execution.

Familiarity with invoice-to-pay, spend management, consolidation, or planning and budgeting software such as Medius, Expensify, Aaro, or NSPB.
Experience working across ERP and CRM ecosystems, including Salesforce integrations, paired with knowledge of modern DevOps practices and agile ways of working.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Test Automation Engineer

Galway, Ireland

Role Overview:

You will design, build and own the automated testing capability underpinning releases for a B2B SaaS platform serving enterprise clients.
This is a hands-on engineering role. You will be responsible for replacing manual test execution with reliable, maintainable automation integrated into CI/CD pipelines, and for raising the overall quality engineering standard of the team.

Key Responsibilities:

Automation design and development
Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks covering functional, regression, API and end-to-end scenarios.
Develop and maintain automated test suites for web applications, REST APIs and platform integrations.
Identify existing manual test cases suitable for automation, prioritise them by risk and effort, and systematically convert them.
Build and manage the test data, environments and fixtures needed to run suites reliably and repeatably.

CI/CD and quality engineering
Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines so that quality feedback is delivered on every build.
Define and maintain quality gates, coverage targets and release criteria alongside engineering leads.
Monitor suite health, investigate and eliminate flaky tests, and keep execution times within acceptable limits.
Report on quality metrics — coverage, pass rates, defect escape rates — and use them to drive improvement.

Quality assurance and collaboration
Work with developers, DevOps and product stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and testable requirements from the outset.
Perform exploratory and risk-based testing where automation is not appropriate, and carry out root-cause analysis on escaped defects.
Support non-functional testing, including performance, load and security-related validation.
Mentor colleagues in automation practice and promote quality ownership across the wider team.
Evaluate and adopt new tooling, including AI-assisted testing approaches, where it demonstrably improves coverage or reduces effort.

Education:

A technology, engineering or computer science related bachelor’s degree, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

Mandatory Candidate Requirements:

4+ years’ experience in test automation within a commercial software or B2B SaaS environment.
Strong programming ability in at least one of Python, Java, C# or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the capability to build and maintain a framework rather than only write scripts.
Hands-on experience with modern UI automation tooling such as Playwright, Selenium or Cypress.
Demonstrable experience automating API and integration testing (for example REST Assured, Postman/Newman, pytest or equivalent).
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps, and working with source control and branching workflows.
Solid grounding in test design: risk-based prioritisation, coverage analysis, and knowing what should and should not be automated.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Native proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable but not Mandatory:

Performance and load testing experience (JMeter, k6, Locust or similar).
Working knowledge of Azure cloud services, containerisation and infrastructure-as-code.
SQL and database testing experience.
Experience with AI-assisted test generation, maintenance or triage tooling.
Security testing awareness (for example OWASP fundamentals).
ISTQB or equivalent certification.

What about you?
This is the most important part. The role suits an engineer who takes genuine ownership of quality, is curious about why defects occur rather than just that they did, and who wants to build something durable rather than patch what exists.
You will be joining a collaborative and highly regarded team where engineering standards are taken seriously, so we are looking for people who understand what it takes to sustain that.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Leading & Directly managing a cross functional team of 8-12 engineers
Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

What We Are Looking For

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment
A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software
Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.
Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners
Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases
Work effectively in an agile environment, using its practices to deliver value consistently and adapt quickly
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Our Tech Stack

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You’ll Get In Return

The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €68,400 to €101,250 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
25 days paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
Additional health & dental insurance
Mental wellbeing platform
Fully covered Multisports card
Food vouchers
Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
WFH equipment allowance
Flexible working from home
Sabbatical Leave
Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets.

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred Selection Criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

Experience from the software industry
Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

A good team player
A good communicator
Eager to learn
Results-oriented
Work independently

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

An exciting job with an important mission in society
Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
Working capital that can be used to implement the project
Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About The Application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note:
the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The Application Must Include

Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
CV
Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages)
Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
Possibly certificates
Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

The city of Trondheim
is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Computer Science

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

🚀 Vil du være med å bygge AI inn i kjernen av vår SaaS-plattform?

Hos Vince har vi siden 2010 hatt ett mål: å gjøre ERP bedre. Vi utvikler smarte apper og leverer konsulenttjenester som hjelper over 250 selskaper med bedre kontroll, automatisering og innsikt i sine forretningsprosesser og verdikjeder. Nå tar vi AI enda dypere inn i produktet – fra arbeidsflytautomatisering og app-bygging til smartere testing, datahåndtering og anbefalinger.

Vi ser etter en senior software engineer som vil være med å forme neste generasjon av vår SaaS-plattform, Vince Live. Dette er en hands-on rolle i Oslo-teamet vårt, hvor du jobber tett med CTO, produktledere, produkteiere og vår arkitekt for å bygge nye produktmuligheter og få oss til å bevege oss raskere – uten å gå på kompromiss med kvalitet, sikkerhet eller skalerbarhet.

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker reelt eierskap og som liker å bygge praktisk AI-funksjonalitet inn i et produkt kundene faktisk bruker. Vi leter ikke etter noen som bare vil eksperimentere med AI – vi leter etter noen som kan gjøre AI-ideer om til stabil produktfunksjonalitet kundene kan stole på.

✨ Hva du får jobbe med

Bygge nye produktfunksjoner fra idé til produksjon
Designe og utvikle robuste backend-tjenester
Bruke moderne AI-APIer, agenter og verktøyrammeverk i reelle produktfunksjoner
Jobbe med AI-assistert produktutvikling og intern utviklerverktøy
Forbedre skalerbarhet, ytelse og pålitelighet
Jobbe med databaser, APIer og integrasjoner
Bidra til arkitekturbeslutninger
Bygge brukervendt funksjonalitet sammen med produkt og design
Være med å forbedre hvordan vi bruker AI internt i utvikling og testing
Delta i vakttjeneste ved kritiske produksjonshendelser
Bidra til å heve det tekniske nivået i teamet

🧩 Hvem vi tror du er

Du har solid erfaring med Node.js
Du har erfaring med Vue eller Angular
Du har erfaring med å utvikle programvare i Python
Du har god forståelse for databaser, APIer og skalerbar arkitektur
Du har hands-on erfaring med AWS
Du har bygget produksjonssystemer, ikke bare prototyper
Du har erfaring med AI-APIer, AI-agenter eller moderne AI-utviklingsverktøy
Du følger godt med i et AI-landskap i rask utvikling, inkludert LLM-er og agentbaserte systemer
Du kan jobbe selvstendig med lite oppfølging
Du tør å utfordre tekniske beslutninger på en konstruktiv måte
Du kommuniserer godt med både tekniske og produktfolk
Du liker å bygge produkter som er nyttige, pålitelige og enkle å bruke

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring fra:

B2B SaaS
Høyvolum B2B eller B2C-systemer
ERP-integrasjoner
Supply chain eller forretningsprosessautomatisering
Workflow-automatisering
App-byggere, low-code eller no-code-plattformer
Enterprise-programvare
Sikkerhets- eller compliance-tunge miljøer

Du trenger ikke å være machine learning-forsker. Det viktigste er at du er en solid software engineer som forstår hvordan AI kan brukes praktisk, pålitelig og verdifullt.

💡 Hvorfor du kommer til å trives hos oss

Du blir en del av et voksende Oslo-basert produkt- og teknologiteam med høy grad av eierskap. Vi jobber tett på tvers av produkt, design og utvikling, og vi verdsetter folk som kommuniserer tydelig, tar gode tekniske beslutninger og får ting gjort. Du rapporterer til CTO og samarbeider tett med produktledere, produkteiere, arkitekt og resten av utviklerteamet.
Rollen er hybrid, med base på vårt Oslo-kontor. Du bør beherske engelsk flytende og forstå norsk.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger og stor fleksibilitet i hverdagen. Du blir del av et sosialt og inkluderende miljø med jevnlige happenings og årlige firmaturer, og får en ekstra ferieuke fordi vi mener folk yter best når de får tid til å koble av og hente ny energi. 🏖️

🚀 Har du lyst til å bygge AI-funksjonalitet kundene faktisk stoler på? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment

Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners
Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases

Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You’ll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

Private Health Insurance
Mental Health Support Platform

model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

We are Forge Digital – a technology agency with cutting-edge solutions and strong domain knowledge in digitalization across manufacturing, retail & logistics, and energy. As a Senior Developer or Architect at Forge, you will design and build robust, scalable systems – from operational and business applications to industrial operator interfaces and real-time situational awareness solutions. Development of AI-powered solutions: applied AI for decisioning, optimization, and predictive systems, as well as agentic and generative AI capabilities embedded directly into business applications
Development of operational work-enhancing solutions and real-time situational awareness systems
Development of integrations connecting production, business, and automation systems (IT/OT)

Business-critical and high-availability system development
Legacy system modernization for AI-assisted development practices

AI-assisted development

Domain knowledge

Cloud and infrastructure mindset

Experience building and integrating LLM-based solutions, including agentic workflows and MCP-based systems
Experience with industrial data exchange standards such as OPC UA or similar IT/OT integration patterns
Frontend development experience (React or similar)
Python and data engineering or analytics background

More than anything, we value a learning-oriented mindset and genuine willingness to keep developing your skills.

Lunch benefit
ePassi Flex budget of 1 000 €/year
Mobile phone benefit
Home internet
Health and accident insurance
Daily refreshments at the office

Your supervisor will be there to spar on personal learning, career development, and possible training needs.

Our recruitment process

You can also share your LinkedIn profile or attach any other relevant documents you wish. Apply soon, as we will process applications during the application period. Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment

In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. Our mission is to reshape the tech consulting industry by introducing a new way of connecting talent (Dev2Dev). In just a few years, Wave has grown into a team of around 50 highly skilled professionals.

Read more about Wave here, and you're also welcome to join the Wave Company project channel on Slack.

You'll work on technically demanding customer projects where your expertise has a real impact. Depending on the assignment, you'll either join as an individual specialist or as part of a cross-functional Wave team.

Our customers span multiple industries, including weather and environmental intelligence, clean energy, mobile gaming, deep tech, retail and logistics. What they have in common is a need for experienced engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems.

Depending on your background, your work may focus on:

Software Engineering –
Full Stack, Frontend and Backend development

Building AI-powered solutions and data-driven architectures
DevOps & Cloud –
Designing scalable, secure and automated cloud environments

Strengthening resilience in business-critical systems

Test automation and quality engineering

Depending on the project, you can work remotely, in a hybrid setup or at the customer's office. We respect your autonomy and always aim to find a setup that works well for both you and the customer.

What we expect from you

As a Senior professional at Wave, you're more than a software developer. You're a consultant, problem-solver and trusted technical expert.

We're looking for someone who has:

Strong experience in modern software development, cloud engineering or software architecture
The ability to communicate technical topics clearly with customers and stakeholders

We offer comprehensive occupational healthcare, high-quality home and work connectivity, and leadership that understands the realities of senior consulting.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job 

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React. 

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Job Requirements

Required skills:

3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset 
Experience with Git  

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have): 

Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product. 

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at holde vores kunders data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – og lære af nogle af branchens dygtigste undervejs?

Vi søger en nysgerrig og struktureret Associate til vores Service Delivery-team. Du får en fod inden for drift af moderne dataplatforme fra dag ét, med erfarne kolleger tæt på og en klar oplæring i vores runbooks og processer.

Service Delivery holder kundernes data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – pålideligt, kontinuerligt og i stor skala. Teamet håndterer incidents, driver problemløsning frem mod systemiske fixes frem for gentagne workarounds, automatiserer driftsopgaver og bruger AI-agenter til at forbedre svartid og servicekvalitet.

Som Associate bliver du en del af den daglige drift af kundernes dataplatforme og indgår i vores supportvagt kl. 07:00-17:00, hvor du håndterer standardincidents efter godkendte runbooks under vejledning fra erfarne kolleger.

Din rolle hos Inspari

Som Associate Operations Engineer er du med til at sikre, at kundernes dataplatforme kører stabilt og forudsigeligt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kolleger og tager gradvist mere ansvar, efterhånden som du bliver tryg i rollen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:
Overvåge alerts og håndtere standardincidents inden for scope ved hjælp af godkendte runbooks.
Udføre restarts, re-runs og validering af data loads og refreshes.
Bruge AI til at opsummere incidents, give forslag til runbook-opdateringer og fremskynde log-analyse – altid med validering, før noget output bruges aktivt.
Dokumentere fund og bidrage til løbende forbedring af runbooks og known-issues.
Eskalere korrekt med tydelig kontekst og evidens, når en sag ligger uden for scope.
Give klare skriftlige opdateringer i tickets, Teams og mail efter en simpel struktur (Hvad er der sket / Status nu / Næste skridt / Ansvarlig) og sikre gode overdragelser, så den næste kollega kan fortsætte uden at miste kontekst.
Deltage aktivt i supportvagten kl. 07:00-17:00

Sådan bliver du en succes i rollen

Du håndterer standardincidents og service requests konsekvent og korrekt ved hjælp af etablerede runbooks.
Du leverer klar dokumentation og gode overdragelser, som gør det nemt for kolleger at tage over.
Du bruger AI-værktøjer ansvarligt – med fokus på korrekthed, ingen misbrug af følsomme data og altid validering før handling.
Du deltager pålideligt i supportvagten med forudsigelig udførelse og tydelige overdragelser.

Din profil

Denne rolle er skabt til dig, der er tidligt i din karriere. Du behøver ikke have en lang erfaring i bagagen – bare en solid teknisk grundforståelse og lyst til at lære. Rollen giver dig et bredt indblik i drift af moderne dataplatforme og kan være et naturligt afsæt til videre specialisering inden for fx AI, data platform eller platform engineering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:
Har en grundlæggende forståelse af dataplatforme, databaser og cloud-teknologier – gerne med kendskab til Microsoft Azure, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, Databricks eller lignende.
Har stærke analytiske evner og kan fejlfinde struktureret.
Kommunikerer klart med både kunder og tekniske kolleger.
Arbejder struktureret med incidents, opgaver og dokumentation.
Tager ejerskab for mindre tekniske opgaver og følger dem til dørs.
Har gode engelsk- og tyskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Derudover er du nysgerrig, proaktiv og har lyst til at lære. Du har en stærk ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og trives med direkte kundekontakt. Du kan holde hovedet koldt, når flere sager kører samtidig, og du er ikke bange for at spørge og lære af erfarne kolleger, mens du gradvist tager mere ansvar.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:
En struktureret oplæring i vores runbooks, processer og vidensystemer
Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger i Service Delivery og på tværs af Platform Engineering og Data Platform-teams
Mulighed for at arbejde med AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af driften
En klar vej til mere ansvar og faglig udvikling, efterhånden som du vokser i rollen
Certificeringsforløb, der klæder dig på fagligt
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork

Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Kgs. Lyngby (København) eller Lystrup (Aarhus), hvor arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret og hjemmearbejde.

Rejseaktivitet

Rollen indebærer en vis rejseaktivitet, som planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.

Ansøg nu

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.
Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. BUILD MARKETS. SHAPE ECONOMIES.
At SGX Group, we create markets. We turn ideas into products and expand access to new opportunities. We are building the future of the exchange in-house: from architecture and platforms to the critical systems that power markets. The biggest decisions are still open to people who join us now.

The opportunity
The Executive Director, Software Engineering is a seasoned technology leader responsible for shaping SGX’s enterprise software engineering vision, platform strategy, and technical operating model. This role holds broad accountability for engineering excellence across architecture, platform resilience, governance, and leadership capability, ensuring SGX’s technology estate remains secure, scalable, and future-ready. Working across multiple teams and domains, the role translates strategic priorities into modern engineering practices, drives critical technology decisions, raises technical standards, and enables senior engineering leaders to deliver high-performing platforms that strengthen SGX’s long-term competitiveness, innovation, and operational resilience.
This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of software engineering at SGX by influencing enterprise architecture, platform strategy, and the engineering practices that underpin critical market infrastructure. It is suited for a leader who is motivated by building long-term capability, modernising engineering at scale, and leaving a lasting impact on how technology enables business growth, resilience, and innovation.
Beyond immediate leadership accountability, the role provides a compelling career path into broader enterprise technology leadership, with opportunities to deepen influence across strategy, engineering transformation, architecture governance, and organisational capability building. It is an ideal platform for a senior leader seeking to expand enterprise impact, develop the next generation of engineering leadership, and play a defining role in SGX’s technology evolution.

The Software Engineering team
Software Engineering builds, runs and evolves the applications and platforms behind SGX Group's business and market infrastructure.
The team works closely with product, architecture, platform, security and delivery colleagues to turn business priorities into secure, resilient and scalable services. Its remit spans the full engineering lifecycle, from technical design and delivery through to production ownership and continuous improvement.
Our next phase is about strengthening engineering ownership, modernising platforms and practices and building consistency across teams without flattening the different needs of each business domain.

What you will do
Software Development: Define the enterprise engineering vision and drive transformation of the software delivery process across SGX Tech.
Software Design: Shape enterprise-wide software architecture strategy and technology evolution.
Secure Software Development: Define Tech org-wide application security and engineering risk strategy.
Testing & Quality Engineering: Drive Tech org-wide quality transformation and delivery assurance strategy.
System Integration: Define Tech org-wide integration and interoperability strategy.
SDLC & Delivery Excellence: Drive Tech org-wide operational resilience and service reliability direction.
Observability & Production Support: Define organisational service ownership and operational excellence strategy.
Automation & Productivity: Lead organisational productivity strategy and investment priorities, driving productivity transformation through automation and AI.
Leadership & Mentoring: Define engineering culture, workforce strategy and long-term capability development.
Agentic AI Engineering: Reimagine software delivery around AI-native operating models and ecosystem capabilities.
Act as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to business and technology stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and positioning engineering as a driver of resilience, innovation, and competitive advantage.

What we are looking for
Experience: Extensive experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering or technology leadership roles, with accountability for multiple engineering teams, senior leaders or enterprise platforms in complex, high-availability environments.
Track record: Strong track record of defining enterprise engineering direction and translating strategy into scalable operating models, governance frameworks and long-term platform evolution.
Technical stack: Deep expertise in modern distributed systems including microservices, service mesh and observability platforms, with strong cloud platform knowledge across AWS EKS, Azure AKS and GCP GKE, and advanced knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices such as incident management, chaos engineering and capacity planning.
Standards & environment: Track record of improving operational resilience and service maturity across mission-critical, regulated enterprise platforms.
Communication & leadership: Proven ability to lead leaders and scale engineering organisations through mentoring, upskilling strategies and performance frameworks, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence major technology decisions and align engineering outcomes with enterprise priorities.
Education & certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information and Communications Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
Domain Knowledge: Exposure to financial market infrastructure, including securities and derivatives trading, clearing, settlement, market operations, or exchange-related systems.

Why this role matters
You will work on technology that underpins critical market infrastructure, where engineering decisions have direct consequences for the business, its customers and the markets it serves. Not many engineering roles carry that weight.
The mandate is real. You will shape how platforms are engineered, owned and evolved, and what software engineering becomes at SGX Group. The work is demanding and the organisation is still changing, which is exactly where the opportunity sits. There are not many chances in a career to build something that outlasts you.

About SGX Group
SGX Group is one of the world's most trusted international marketplaces, known for its stability and openness. Anchored in Singapore, we enable price discovery, capital formation and risk management across asset classes, supported by resilient infrastructure and robust clearing. We convene issuers, investors and intermediaries to create and grow markets that stand the test of time. Find out more at www.SGX Group.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Site Reliability
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

At UiPath’s Site Reliability team, we build the platforms and systems that the entire company depends on to deliver on our compliance and SLA promises to customers. This spans monitoring, alerting, cloud infrastructure, access management, standardized synthetics, performance and test validation, incident detection and status reporting, incident management, automated remediation, structured post-mortems, customer communications, repair item tracking, and assertion of engineering best practices across UiPath. We are scaling each of these pillars - and building the next generation of capabilities on each, increasingly powered by AI.

This is a software engineering role.

You will not be the person who identifies a reliability gap and files a ticket for another team to fix. You are the engineer who identifies the gap, designs the system that closes it, builds it, ships it, and drives its adoption - often by doing the integration work yourself rather than asking other teams to come to you. You build platforms that other engineers depend on in their critical path, and you hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not outputs.

You treat every system you ship as a product: you put it in front of users early, seek feedback, and iterate until it delivers real results. If adoption is slow, you don’t blame the docs - you sit with the team, understand the friction, and remove it.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Design, engineer, and build SRE platform systems and capabilities with cutting-edge AI, treating them as products that other engineering teams depend on in their critical path.
Participate in livesite monitoring rotations, handle escalations, and drive effective mitigations - reducing customer impact through broad, detailed, and effective post-mortems.
Drive availability, scalability, and performance improvements based on livesite learnings. Generate (or codify existing) best practices and ensure they are followed widely across UiPath - not by publishing guidance, but by embedding them into the systems you build.
Ensure technical deliverables meet or exceed expectations on reliability, scalability, quality, and performance. Identify and drive architectural changes that significantly move the needle on these dimensions.
Onboard other teams onto your platforms by driving outcomes yourself - writing the integrations, pairing with their engineers, removing friction - rather than handing off documentation and waiting.
Ship early, seek feedback relentlessly, and iterate fast. Treat every user complaint as a design input, not a support ticket.
Drive task planning, estimation, scheduling, and staffing.
Mentor Software Engineers to develop their skills and knowledge through hands-on coaching, advice, and training opportunities.
Participate in and influence process improvements and best practices across the engineering organization.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Proven track record (10+ years) of architecting and engineering world-class, large-scale, distributed commercial applications and services, and ensuring customer success.
Experience building large-scale, complex internal platforms adopted by 10+ teams in their critical path at a large company — systems that have stood the test of time, not prototypes that were handed off or abandoned.
Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of your systems by doing the hard work yourself: writing integrations, removing friction for other teams, and measuring success by outcomes delivered - not features shipped.
Experience building and maintaining complex AI-powered applications in production.
Proficiency in one or more object-oriented languages (such as C#, C++, Java, or Python), backed by solid computer science fundamentals.
Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, multithreading, synchronization, asynchronous patterns, and cloud programming.
Experience with service-oriented and microservice-based architectures, HTTP applications, and web services development.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices including agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps. Ability to work with globally distributed teams.
Experience working with or managing production Kubernetes infrastructure is a plus.

jobs.description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction.

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Rust Developer to join one of our high-growth client teams as a technical lead for their core systems. In an era where performance and memory safety are non-negotiable, you will be responsible for architecting and building low-latency, high-throughput services that serve as the backbone of the client's platform.

You will lead the transition from legacy services to high-performance Rust microservices, leveraging the ownership model to eliminate data races and ensure memory safety. This is a role for a developer who loves "getting close to the metal" while maintaining the productivity of a modern web stack.

What we are looking for:

Professional experience building production-grade applications in Rust. You should have a deep understanding of ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, and the Send/Sync traits.
Strong experience with the Tokio ecosystem and asynchronous programming patterns.
Proficiency with modern Rust web frameworks such as Axum, Actix-web, or Rocket.
Proven ability to design distributed systems using gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and message brokers like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Advanced knowledge of SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) and experience with asynchronous ORMs or query builders like sqlx or Diesel.
Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/K8s) and deploying Rust services to cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Experience with profiling tools (e.g., flamegraph, valgrind) to identify and resolve bottlenecks in high-load scenarios.
Strong verbal and written English; comfortable leading technical discussions with cross-functional stakeholders.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-Have:

Experience with WebAssembly (Wasm) for edge computing or browser-based logic.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Pulumi).
Familiarity with "Unsafe Rust" and when (and when not) to use it.
Background in low-level systems languages like C or C++.

Responsibilities:

Design and implement highly performant backend services that are robust, maintainable, and type-safe.
Lead the shift toward memory-safe distributed systems, ensuring zero-cost abstractions are utilized effectively.
Conduct rigorous code reviews, emphasizing idiomatic Rust ("Rustacean" style) and safety best practices.
Architect secure and scalable RESTful and gRPC APIs for consumption by frontend and mobile applications.
Maintain high code quality through comprehensive unit, integration, and property-based testing.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

Predictable project hours

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge

Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies

Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

One seamless process, multiple opportunities

A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Compensation

Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.
