jobs.title: AI Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe?

We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Are you ready to shape the future through technology? Your journey starts here. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

Job Description

So, what are the main responsibilities of the AI Principal Engineer
in Netcompany’s Enterprise Solutions?

Joining us as an AI Principal Engineer
, you will lead the design, delivery, and scaling of advanced GenAI, LLM, and Machine Learning (ML) solutions for enterprise clients across both public and private sectors. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of technical leadership, people management, and client engagement, driving impactful AI initiatives from concept to production.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating complex AI capabilities into clear business value, while leading and mentoring a high-performing team of AI/ML engineers. As a Principal (Manager-level role), you will be accountable not only for technical excellence but also for team growth, delivery quality, and client success.

This is a highly client-facing leadership role. Your ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, align business and technology priorities, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive leadership will be key to success. You will represent the AI function in strategic discussions, lead workshops, and shape enterprise AI adoption roadmaps.

You will focus on the architecture and delivery of scalable, production-grade AI systems, ensuring solutions are reusable, extensible, and aligned with best practices, while pushing the boundaries of innovation beyond off-the-shelf tools.

As The AI Principal Engineer, You Will

Serve as the primary AI and ML advisor to enterprise clients, translating business challenges into scalable AI-driven solutions with measurable impact.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Drive the end-to-end architecture and delivery of ML and GenAI pipelines, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
Collaborate closely with MLOps, DevOps, and data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple projects, including executive communication, reporting, and risk management.
Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and technical presentations to define AI strategies and accelerate adoption.
Oversee delivery quality, ensuring solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and governance standards.
Contribute to practice development, including methodology, tooling, reusable assets, and pre-sales activities.

Qualifications

What would make you a fit for the role:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, Operational Research, or a related field (PhD is a plus).
8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions from concept to production.
Proven experience in a leadership or management role, including team leadership, mentoring, and performance management.
Strong experience in client-facing environments, including leading workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders (C-level, board members).
Deep expertise in Machine Learning and GenAI, including LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Gemini), RAG architectures and prompt engineering, Agentic AI systems and orchestration frameworks.
Solid understanding of MLOps practices, model lifecycle management, and production deployment patterns.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks and tooling, including open-source ecosystems.

It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:

Experience in consulting, systems integration, or professional services environments.
Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and LLM monitoring frameworks.
Experience with advanced GenAI frameworks (e.g., LlamaIndex, LangGraph) and evaluation tools.
Exposure to AIOps practices and production AI observability.
Experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, or business development in AI/data domains.

Additional Information

Being a part of the Netcompany team, you will be provided with:

The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working model
A seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first steps
A competitive compensation & benefits package
Health and life insurance program
Meal and commuting allowance
Well-being activities (on premises)
Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)
A personalized development plan for targeted career growth

If you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!

By joining Netcompany in Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2,300+ tech professionals. When at the office, you'll have the flexibility to work from our three modern, sustainable, and state-of-the-art offices!

Please upload your CV in English
via the Apply button. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.

We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our everyday working experience.

In the following link you may find our CV Submission privacy notice: https://netcompany.com/cv-submission-privacy-notice/

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

In this role, you’ll contribute directly to Axon™
, our Digital Twin SaaS platform. We’re looking for Software Engineers who are curious, analytically strong, and excited to grow in an intellectually challenging product environment.

A background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field will provide a strong foundation for success in this role. Beyond that, we value strong reasoning skills, an interest in software development, and the ambition to continuously learn and improve.

You join the backend Analytics team within Product & Engineering: a close‑knit team of 20+ data scientists and engineers working closely with product owners to deliver end‑to‑end platform features.
You help build and evolve the analytical backbone of the Axon platform.
You translate strong abstract and analytical thinking into real‑world software solutions.
You integrate customer data into scalable data models, building complex graph structures, analytical logic, and advanced capabilities for calculations, simulations, and querying.
You know what clean, production‑ready code looks like. You have a strong focus on quality and maintainability.
You build and extend a sophisticated backend, using .NET.
You use AI -curiously and with judgement- to explore design options, write and improve code, validate tests, and speed up repetitive work.
You’ll report to the Lead Software Engineer of Axon technology.

Job Requirements

About you

We value people with a strong technical foundation, a growth mindset, curiosity, and the drive to build solutions that create real impact.

Have a strong analytical and abstract reasoning mindset and enjoy mathematics, complex systems, and intellectual challenges.
Hold a master’s degree in fields such as (Civil) Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or similar.
Have a strong interest in software development . Prior development experience is a big plus, but not required.
Are curious about how AI is reshaping software development and eager to grow with it.
Enjoy understanding how technical choices connect to real business impact.
Are fluent in Dutch & English.
Feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind!

Why join us?

Strong onboarding, daily collaboration and coaching by experienced engineers to help you grow fast.
The chance to build a strong foundation for your software engineering career.
Work on one growing SaaS product, instead of jumping from one short project to another.
Build deep product and technical knowledge over time, so you can become an expert faster.
High-impact work on real-life, complex supply chain problems.
An intellectually challenging environment where deep thinking is valued.
AI-enabled development that helps you focus on creativity, problem-solving, and quality.
A fun culture that values ownership, curiosity, kindness, and helping each other succeed.
Flexible working hours and a 50/50 hybrid model from our Mechelen office.
Alongside a competitive salary and bonus, you'll have the choice between a flexible mobility budget or an electric company car with convenient charging facilities.

About us

Start your career shaping the future of supply chains.

Bluecrux is a value chain consulting and technology company, specializing in transformative solutions for today’s complex supply chain landscape. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we’re committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Axon
helps companies bring scattered supply chain data together in one clear view, so our clients can better understand what is happening, make smarter decisions, and act faster. Our platform is used especially in Life Sciences and Healthcare, where supply chains are highly complex, and decisions can directly impact product launches, availability, and access to medicines. By helping companies see their supply chain more clearly, Axon supports faster product launches, better use of working capital, and more room for investment in research and development.

Axon is also still in a scale-up phase. There is a strong product vision, many new ideas to build, and a lot of product innovation still ahead.

Job Purpose

As an H&F embedded Software Engineer
, you will be responsible for the timely development of application software for our Self Propelled Forage Harvester products. The successful applicant will be specifying, designing, and testing vehicle application and control software per CNH coding standards .

As part of the H&F Integration team you are crucial in delivering new mechatronic features on Multi ECU, Multi CAN vehicle network architectures for this high performance agricultural equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Define the control system software requirements, software specification and software structure for vehicle applications
Maintain, archive, and control application source code, manage SW releases
Implement the software architecture and strategies, requirements for closed loop control algorithms, User Interface and related software control logic dealing with complex product offering
Perform unit testing and system integration testing with the hardware and software, via simulation and on-board executions.
Define & Execute test scenarios to verify the implemented control / monitoring strategy
Support Product Validation and Verification Engineers as they conduct Functional and Performance testing
Analyse and interpret field data to improve feature development and troubleshooting. (i.e. CAN traces)
Produce documentation in support of design, implementation, and test activities

Experience Required

Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical, Computer or similar engineering discipline
Experience/knowledge of using C & C# Programming language
Experience with industry coding standards for software development such as MISRA-C
Experience with CAN and/or LIN protocols and diagnostic tools such as Vector CANalyzer®
Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities and experience
Ability to interpret & implement vehicle networking protocols
Proficient in English, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using MATLAB® Simulink/Stateflow and Automatic code generation
Experience with code debuggers, code analysis, and memory management
Experience with automated testing (Phyton, CAPL, etc)
Experience with SAE J1939, CAN, UDS
Experience with Electro-Hydraulic or vehicle control systems for on/off-highway vehicle systems
Demonstrated knowledge SW engineering systems tools such as SVN, Polarion, Azure, GIT
Demonstrated technical leadership and organization/control skills
Experience with network client/server architecture
Experience with agricultural equipment and/or machines
Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

What We Offer

At CNH we offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

Working at CNH means working in an environment where, thanks in part to its international character, numerous development opportunities are available. More than 2,500 people work at CNH Belgium’s site in Zedelgem. This single location houses various departments, ranging from design—with an R&D center employing around 400 people—to production, service, dealer training, and all support departments.

CNH Belgium in Zedelgem is also located in a traffic-free area and is easily accessible.

We offer a very attractive salary package with numerous fringe benefits such as insurance, eco vouchers, meal vouchers, a cafeteria plan (Flex Ben), and no less than 20.5 working time reduction days on top of the statutory vacation days (in a full-time system).

Are you as passionate as our people? Would you like to be part of a great team and help build the most innovative and largest agricultural machines on the market? Apply now!

design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise

Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS
integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.

Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For

4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a
greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.

Personal Characteristics

Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

jobs.description:
Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer to work hybrid 60% on-site in Belgium or Czech Republic.

TITLE Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)
START DATE 5 Oct 2026
END DATE 5 Mar 2027
LOCATION Kontich, Belgium or Czech Republic
LANGUAGES English
hybrid 60% on-site in

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

METTLER TOLEDO ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Präzisionsinstrumenten und Dienstleistungen. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.mt.com.
Ihre Aufgaben

Unsere Thermoanalyse-Geräte sind mechatronische Systeme von höchster Qualität und Leistung zur Bestimmung verschiedenster thermischer und mechanischer Eigenschaften. Sie werden von unseren Kunden für Forschung, Entwicklung und Qualitätssicherung von Substanzen und Werkstoffen aller Art eingesetzt. Für unseren globalen Hauptsitz in Nänikon-Greifensee suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Softwareteams einen engagierten Senior Software Engineer 80 – 100% (all genders)
, der die Zukunft unserer PC-basierten Softwarelösungen aktiv mitgestaltet.
In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie folgende Tätigkeiten: Sie wirken bei der Weiterentwicklung einer komplexen, innovativen PC-basierten Applikationssoftware mit.
Sie treiben die Ablösung und Modernisierung bestehender Subsysteme voran, insbesondere im Bereich des integrierten Datenbankmanagementsystems und der grafischen Benutzeroberfläche.
Sie übernehmen Architekturaufgaben zur Abstraktion von Betriebssystem- und Open-Source-Komponenten.
Sie erarbeiten Spezifikationen, Designs und Testkonzepte im Rahmen unseres Entwicklungsprozesses.
Sie unterstützen Produkteinführungen sowie die Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte im Markt.
Sie arbeiten eng mit interdisziplinären Projektteams aus den Bereichen Produktmanagement, Elektronik, Mechanik und Messzellenentwicklung zusammen.

Folgende Anforderungen stellen wir an diese Position: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium (FH, ETH, TU) mit Schwerpunkt Technische Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

Sie bringen gute Kenntnisse in der Architektur von webbasierten Applikationen mit.
Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse von Kommunikationsprotokollen für die sichere Kommunikation mit externen Geräten.
Sie haben Erfahrung in der Entwicklung betriebssystemunabhängiger Anwendungen.
Sie sind vertraut mit Entwicklungsumgebungen wie Visual Studio und Visual Studio Code sowie mit modernen Softwareentwicklungsprozessen.
Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in Application Lifecycle Management, Versionsverwaltung mit Git sowie automatisierten Build- und Deployment-Umgebungen, idealerweise Azure DevOps.
Sie kennen die Anforderungen des EU Cyber Resilience Act und verstehen deren Auswirkungen auf den Softwareentwicklungsprozess.
Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung und gestalten zukunftsweisende Entwicklungen aktiv mit.
Sie zeichnen sich durch Engagement, Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise aus.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. Was machst du als Senior Developer .NET - Agentic Engineering bei Delegate?

Agenten übernehmen Boilerplate, Refactorings, Test-Scaffolding und Code-Suche. Design, Trade-offs und Qualität verantworten Menschen. Gemergt wird nur nach menschlichem Review.

Kein Problem. Neue spannende Technologien auszuprobieren und dich weiterzuentwickeln, dafür hast du Raum bei Delegate.

Was brauchst du für deine Mission?

Erfahrung in der Entwicklung SQL-basierter Datenbankapplikationen, speziell Microsoft SQL Server

Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2) - die Sprache unserer internationalen Standorte

En ABEI estamos construyendo una de las empresas que va a decidir cómo se mueve la energía limpia en este mercado. Lo hacemos a máxima velocidad, en un sector que todavía se está definiendo — lo que significa que las decisiones que tomamos ahora van a pesar durante décadas.
Somos una empresa joven, que va rápido y todavía se está construyendo. Quien llega aquí y lo hace suyo, crece más rápido de lo que crecería en cualquier otro sitio.

Contexto del rol:

ABEI Energy busca desarrolladores de software full-stack para su equipo de producto digital. El equipo diseña y construye las aplicaciones internas que soportan la operativa de la compañía, desde el modelado de datos hasta la interfaz de usuario y su despliegue en producción.
Quien se incorpore al equipo dependerá directamente del CTO.

Se trata de un equipo reducido, autónomo y orientado a la entrega, que trabaja en contacto directo con las áreas de negocio y que ha incorporado las herramientas de desarrollo asistido por inteligencia artificial al núcleo de su método de trabajo. Buscamos profesionales con criterio, que utilizan la IA como amplificador de un buen oficio y que responden por la calidad, la arquitectura y el mantenimiento de lo que construyen, asumiendo la responsabilidad de un producto de principio a fin.

Lo que harás:

Diseñar y desarrollar aplicaciones completas: modelo de datos, API, interfaz de usuario y despliegue.
Desplegar y operar los servicios en Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, pipelines de CI/CD).
Construir integraciones con sistemas corporativos mediante API (Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, Power BI, almacenes de datos).
Colaborar directamente con los usuarios de negocio para trasladar sus necesidades a soluciones de software.
Emplear herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA de forma intensiva y con criterio, respondiendo de la calidad del código entregado.

Lo que esperamos de ti:

Experiencia sólida y demostrable adquirida con anterioridad a la irrupción de la IA generativa: trayectoria escribiendo, depurando y manteniendo software en producción de forma autónoma.
Al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo full-stack en entornos productivos.
Experiencia demostrable en bases de datos: modelado de datos, SQL y optimización de consultas.
Fundamentos técnicos firmes: estructuras de datos, diseño de API, control de versiones con Git, pruebas y despliegue.
Clara visión de arquitectura de aplicaciones, con capacidad para diseñar soluciones mantenibles y escalables.
Capacidad para guiar a la IA con criterio: dirigir la herramienta, evaluar sus resultados y corregir el rumbo cuando es necesario.
Autonomía para llevar una funcionalidad desde su concepción hasta producción.
Inglés a nivel profesional.

Se Valorará:

Uso avanzado y habitual de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA (como Claude Code), con ejemplos concretos de mejora de productividad.
Experiencia con Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, pipelines) y autenticación mediante Entra ID/OAuth.
Experiencia integrando sistemas mediante API (Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, ERP y otros sistemas corporativos).
Trayectoria en equipos reducidos, desarrollo de producto interno o entornos de alta iteración.

¿Por qué trabajar con nosotros?

Ownership desde el primer día. Tendrás procesos que serán tuyos y margen real para cambiarlos cuando no funcionan.
Impacto directo. Trabajarás en operaciones que mueven cartera, no en análisis que acaban en una carpeta.
Crecimiento sin techo artificial. Estamos creciendo más rápido que la mayoría, y eso crea espacio para quien quiere avanzar.
Exposición internacional. Portfolio y equipo con presencia en múltiples mercados.

Lo que ofrecemos:

Salario competitivo, alineado con el mercado.
Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Progresión real en una empresa que no para de crecer.

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a Full Stack
jobs.description:
Guardian Glass Services
es el negocio de B2C de Guardian Glass, dedicado a proyectos de vidrio e instalación de ventanas bajo la marca Venstal, con operaciones en España y Portugal.

Buscamos un/a Desarrollador/a Full-Stack
para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de IT en las oficinas de Bilbao que quiera trabajar en productos digitales con impacto directo en nuestros clientes y en la operación del negocio.

El puesto abarca cuatro áreas principales: nuestro CRM interno, integraciones con aseguradoras, mantenimiento del ERP y la web de captación.

Responsabilidades

Evolucionar y mantener nuestro CRM interno para gestionar el ciclo comercial completo: leads, presupuestos, mediciones, telefonía y atención vía WhatsApp. (Stack: TypeScript, Next.js 16, React, Vercel, Firestore, Redis, React Query).
Diseñar, implementar y mantener integraciones con aseguradoras que soporten el ciclo complete de los expecientes: recepción del aviso, gestión de citas y avisos de llegada, envío/recepción de presupuestos y modificaciones, gestión de fotografías, cierre y facturación. Tecnologías y formatos: REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, OAuth2, certificados cliente y webhooks.
Mantener y modernizar nuestro ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2009 sobre SQL Server). Garantizar continuidad de negocio, estabilidad y calidad en un sistema en producción.
Mejorar la captación digital y experiencia web: mantenimiento y evolución del sitio corporativo multidioma en Drupal 10 (módulo a medida con configurador y Redsys), landing en Astro, optimización de rendimiento (Core Web Vitals) y medición de conversiones.
Gestionar versiones y despliegues mediante Git y GitHub Actions, manteniendo un control fiable de los cambios y de los entornos de desarrollo, pruebas y producción.

Requisitos

Experiencia en desarrollo de software. Uso habitual de TypeScript y Node.js.
Experiencia en desarrollo full-stack, trabajando tanto en front-end como en back-end.
Experiencia práctica diseñando, desarrollando o manteniendo integraciones con APIs de terceros.
Experiencia realizando cambios, diagnosticando incidencias o manteniendo aplicaciones que ya se encuentran en producción.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma con mentalidad de mejora continua.

Se valorará

Experiencia con Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central y C/AL.
Experiencia con PHP y Drupal.
Experiencia con Power BI y Power Automate.
Nivel medio de inglés (hablado y escrito).
Familiaridad con herramientas de inteligencia artificial aplicadas al desarrollo de software.

No buscamos a alguien que domine las cuatro áreas desde el primer día. Buscamos a alguien sólido programando, con ganas de comprender los sistemas, aportar criterio y ampliar progresivamente su ámbito de actuación.

Qué Ofrecemos

Contrato indefinido y posibilidades de desarrollo.
Respaldo de un grupo industrial internacional con la agilidad de una empresa pequeña.
Horario flexible.

Quiénes somos

Como una empresa de Koch, Guardian Glass
es uno de los mayores fabricantes de productos y soluciones de vidrio flotado, fabricado y de valor añadido del mundo. Producimos vidrio de alto rendimiento para aplicaciones arquitectónicas, residenciales, interiores, de transporte y de vidrio técnico. Encontrará nuestro vidrio en hogares, oficinas y automóviles, y en algunos de los proyectos más emblemáticos del mundo.

Guardian Glass Services
es el único negocio B2C dentro de Guardian Glass. Nos dedicamos a la reposición de vidrio para hogar, comercios, venta directa y retail. Con múltiples centros de trabajo y cobertura nacional, somos el principal partner de vidrio para los sectores aseguradores, corporate y nuevas aperturas. En Guardian Glass Services creemos firmemente que la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades son fundamentales para el éxito de nuestra organización. Contamos con un Plan de Igualdad
implantado que promueve la igualdad efectiva entre mujeres y hombres en todos los ámbitos de la empresa, garantizando procesos de selección, desarrollo profesional, formación, promoción y retribución basados exclusivamente en criterios objetivos de mérito y capacidad. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, respetuoso y libre de cualquier tipo de discriminación, donde todas las personas puedan desarrollar su talento y alcanzar su máximo potencial en igualdad de condiciones.

En Koch, los empleados pueden dedicarse a lo que mejor saben hacer para mejorar vidas. Descubra cómo nuestra filosofía de negocio (business philosophy) ayuda a los empleados a explotar su potencial mientras crean valor para ellos y para la empresa.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (Portuguese speaking) - Madrid OR Paris
jobs.description:
FEQ427R550

Solutions Architect - Portuguese speaking.

Location: Madrid or Paris, or within a commutable distance

The Role

As a Solutions Architect, you will lead the technical strategy for your customers — owning architecture discussions, driving platform adoption, and serving as a trusted advisor to customer technical leads and architects. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy. You are developing a technical specialization (archetype) and are recognized within your team for depth in a specific domain.

The Impact You Will Have

Own the end-to-end technical strategy for your accounts, from initial discovery through production deployment and consumption growth
Lead complex architecture discussions — designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects, engineering leads, and Directors
Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions
Develop and declare an emerging technical specialization (archetype) — becoming a go-to resource for your team in that domain
Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

6+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL — you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)
Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders — whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
Experience with production deployments on public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure, security, and governance considerations
Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
Fluency in English and Portuguese
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

Nice To Have

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)
Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider
Industry domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, etc.)

Interview Process:
Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

Buscamos un/a especialista con al menos 3 años de experiencia en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, orientado/a al desarrollo e integración de soluciones dentro de Copilot Service Workspace. La persona seleccionada contribuirá a la evolución de la capa de integración basada en contenedores, participando en proyectos de personalización avanzada e integración de canales dentro del entorno Dynamics 365.

Responsabilidades

Configurar y personalizar soluciones de Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
Desarrollar y mantener integraciones dentro de Copilot Service Workspace.
Implementar y configurar Channel Integration Framework (CIF) para la integración y conexión de aplicaciones externas.
Desarrollar lógica de frontend y funcionalidades personalizadas utilizando JavaScript y TypeScript.
Trabajar con Microsoft APM SDK para habilitar la integración de aplicaciones dentro del entorno Dynamics.
Garantizar el rendimiento, la usabilidad y la mantenibilidad de las soluciones implementadas.
Colaborar con los equipos de backend e integración para asegurar una funcionalidad integral de extremo a extremo.
Participar en la evolución de una arquitectura de integración basada en contenedores dentro de Dynamics 365.

Tu perfil

Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años trabajando con Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
Experiencia práctica en Copilot Service Workspace y Channel Integration Framework (CIF).
Experiencia práctica trabajando con Microsoft APM SDK.
Experiencia sólida en desarrollo con JavaScript dentro de entornos Dynamics.
Capacidad para desarrollar y trabajar con aplicaciones integradas dentro de Microsoft Dynamics 365 mediante una arquitectura basada en contenedores.

Experiencia en desarrollo con TypeScript.
Experiencia en la construcción de integraciones de interfaz de usuario (UI) personalizadas dentro de Dynamics 365.
Conocimiento de patrones de arquitectura frontend en aplicaciones empresariales.
Valoramos todas las candidaturas y ofrecemos formación presencial, online y certificaciones. Aunque no cumplas el 100% de los requisitos, ¡queremos conocerte!

Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí

Trabajarás en un entorno donde se valora la confianza y la autonomía

Catálogo de medidas de Desarrollo y Conciliación muy completo, como son, por ejemplo:

Plan de Compensación Flexible (tickets guardería, seguro médico, tarjeta restaurante o subvención de comida, transporte, formación…)

24 días de vacaciones + 2 asuntos propios + 24 y 31 de diciembre + opción a comprar hasta 7 días de vacaciones al año.
FlexAbroad: posibilidad de trabajar en remoto desde otro país durante 45 días.
Formación continua. Acceso a itinerarios de formación completos en nuestros Campus Virtuales (GenAI, Cloud, Data... ) con oportunidades de certificación. Tendrás acceso gratuito a plataformas como: Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor, Education First para idiomas…

space. This person will be responsible for both project delivery

.

Lead the technical and operational strategy for assigned accounts
, ensuring quality and business value in all deliveries.
Drive farming
initiatives: identify new opportunities, craft innovative proposals, and foster sustainable account growth.
Supervise and coordinate teams of 30–60 professionals
, including managers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
Ensure excellence in project delivery
across Cloud, AI, Big Data, and Microsoft technologies (Azure, .NET, etc.)
.
Play an active role in the definition and presentation of client proposals
, acting as the main technical and business point of contact.
Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and continuous improvement.
Manage client relationships
, ensuring satisfaction and strategic alignment.

Requirements

10+ years of experience
in technology environments, with at least 5 years leading large engineering or delivery teams
.
Proven background in technology consulting
(mandatory).
Demonstrated experience in account farming and growth
, not only project delivery.
Strong technical expertise in web technologies and Microsoft ecosystems
, combined with knowledge of Cloud, AI, and Big Data
.
Experience managing complex projects and international clients
.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish
, both written and spoken.

Salary determined by the market and your experience 🤑

Phone screen.
2 interviews with the team 🤘

jobs.title: Solutions Architect IA & Data
jobs.description:
¿Quiénes somos y qué buscamos?

Bravent
es una empresa especializada en tecnologías Microsoft
donde se impulsa la innovación y, sobre todo, el entorno colaborativo. Buscamos incorporar un/a Solutions Architect – AI & Data
con capacidad para diseñar y liderar arquitecturas end-to-end que combinen soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial, plataformas de datos y analítica, e industrialización sobre Microsoft Azure.

El perfil tendrá una visión transversal de ambos pilares, desde la definición de arquitectura y selección tecnológica hasta el despliegue, escalabilidad, seguridad, observabilidad y operación, con orientación a negocio y a la identificación de casos de uso e impacto real de las soluciones.

Experiencia y requisitos IA

¿Qué harás?

Diseñar arquitecturas de IA generativa, agentes, sistemas multiagente, Machine Learning, Deep Learning y Computer Vision.

Seleccionar servicios, patrones arquitectónicos, modelos y frameworks adecuados según el caso de uso, los requisitos no funcionales y las restricciones del cliente.

Trabajar con Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models, Azure AI Search y los frameworks Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain y LangGraph.

Diseñar estrategias de evaluación, observabilidad, seguridad, gobierno, escalabilidad y optimización de costes.

Evolucionar soluciones desde prototipos hasta arquitecturas preparadas para producción.

Experiencia

Experiencia demostrable diseñando o liderando arquitecturas de IA.

Conocimientos de soluciones de IA generativa, agentes, sistemas multiagente, Machine Learning, Deep Learning y Computer Vision.

Conocimientos de Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain y LangGraph.

Conocimientos de evaluación, observabilidad, seguridad, gobierno, escalabilidad y optimización de costes de soluciones de IA.

Experiencia y requisitos Data

¿Qué harás?

Diseñar arquitecturas end-to-end sobre Azure y Microsoft Fabric, incluyendo OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, Pipelines y Real-Time Intelligence.

Diseñar capas de ingesta, almacenamiento, transformación, modelado, serving y consumo.

Diseñar arquitecturas de integración y procesos ETL/ELT.

Trabajar con Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, SQL Server, Snowflake, Python, T-SQL y Power BI.

Diseñar soluciones de convergencia AI y Data, mediante Fabric Data Agents, arquitecturas RAG sobre datos corporativos e integración entre Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI y Azure AI Search.

Experiencia

Entre 4 y 8 años de experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones de integración y analítica de datos.

Experiencia con grandes volúmenes de datos.

Conocimientos de Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Platform, Data Engineering, integración de fuentes heterogéneas y procesos ETL/ELT.

Conocimientos de SQL Server, Snowflake, Python, T-SQL, Power BI, Azure Databricks y Azure Functions.

Se valorarán conocimientos de Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Purview, CI/CD, Terraform o Bicep, arquitecturas Medallion, Delta Lake, Event Hub, Service Bus, Kafka, Streaming Analytics y MLOps.

Experiencia y requisitos de soporte a negocio

¿Qué harás?

Traducir necesidades y objetivos de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas concretas, escalables, seguras, gobernadas y mantenibles.

Liderar la definición técnica desde las fases de discovery y propuesta hasta la industrialización y puesta en producción.

Participar en la preparación de propuestas de valor y planteamientos técnicos para clientes.

Asegurar que las soluciones estén vinculadas a métricas técnicas y métricas de resultado de negocio.

Coordinarse con equipos de IA, Data, Cloud, Seguridad, Desarrollo y negocio.

Elaborar y mantener documentación de arquitectura, decisiones técnicas, integraciones, flujos, dependencias y criterios de operación.

Experiencia

Participación en proyectos end-to-end, desde discovery y definición de requisitos hasta despliegue, evaluación, monitorización y operación.

Experiencia elaborando documentación y defendiendo decisiones de arquitectura ante equipos técnicos y de negocio.

Conocimientos de metodologías Agile: Scrum y/o Kanban.

Git y Azure DevOps.

Visión de arquitectura end-to-end, autonomía técnica, capacidad analítica y resolución de problemas complejos.

Comunicación efectiva con clientes, negocio y equipos técnicos, así como capacidad para explicar decisiones complejas a audiencias no técnicas.

Liderazgo técnico durante la definición, construcción e industrialización de las soluciones.

Buen nivel de inglés.

Teletrabajo.

Formación.

Seguro médico.

jobs.title: Junior Powerapps Developer Intern
jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there future intern!

I am Álvaro,
the recruiter for this position (and hopefully, your future colleague!).

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center
: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich
!

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

jobs.title: Integrations & Data Migration Architect - Microsoft Dynamics CRM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join Liebherr, a global leader in engineering and manufacturing, as we advance our digital transformation journey. We are looking for a motivated
Integrations & Data Migration Architect - Microsoft Dynamics CRM (m/f/d)
to play a key role in our newly established IT Shared Service Center in Madrid.
In this role, you will own and shape the integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global CRM solution (OneCRM), supporting its deployment across our international Sales and Service Companies. You will ensure reliable and scalable data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
You will define and govern the end-to-end approach for data migration across global rollout waves, from source data analysis and mapping through cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and final migration. Combining architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise, you will help ensure high levels of data quality, integrity, and operational reliability. You will be part of an international, cross-functional team that values innovation, methodology, and long-term thinking, making a direct impact on the way Liebherr serves its customers worldwide.
The working location for this position will be in Madrid city, where we operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of working time spent on-site on a weekly basis.

Creating passion: your responsibilities

Own the end-to-end integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solution.
Define and govern integration patterns and data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
Define and drive the data migration approach for global CRM rollouts, including source analysis, data mapping, transformation, cleansing, enrichment, validation, reconciliation, and loading.
Establish reusable migration standards, tools, and templates to enable consistent and industrialized global deployments.
Define data synchronization and master data exchange mechanisms, ensuring reliable and maintainable data flows.
Coordinate data cleansing and migration readiness with business stakeholders, data owners, and rollout teams.
Maintain transparency of critical data flows, system dependencies, data ownership, and system responsibilities across the OneCRM landscape.
Provide technical leadership to Dynamics and integration developers, implementation partners, and other technical teams.
Maintain architecture and technical documentation for integrations, data models, mappings, and migration concepts using tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Travel (up to 30%) to Liebherr sites worldwide to support architecture, migration, and rollout activities.

Contributing your strengths: your qualifications

7+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, data architecture, data migration, or related technical roles within complex IT landscapes.
Proven experience designing and executing large-scale data migrations and enterprise system integrations, ideally within international transformation or rollout programs.
Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse, including a solid understanding of data structures and integration capabilities.
Deep understanding of data mapping, transformation, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, synchronization, and master data management principles.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Azure integration technologies, APIs, event-driven integration, and enterprise integration architecture patterns.
Experience with SQL and relevant tools and technologies for data analysis, transformation, migration, integration, and validation.
Strong architectural and analytical capabilities, with the ability to understand complex multi-system landscapes and translate them into scalable and maintainable data flows.
Ability to combine architectural thinking with hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving, with a strong focus on data quality and reliability.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical teams, business stakeholders, data owners, external partners, and international organizations.
Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages (e.g., German or Spanish) and relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, or integration architecture certifications are considered a strong advantage.

Our commitment to you: your benefits

As an internationally successful family business, the Liebherr Group offers you a secure job, a unique variety of tasks and exciting development opportunities. Become part of our strong team today and get to know the Liebherr Group as a reliable partner. Profit from these benefits:
Competitive compensation and benefits package that recognizes your expertise

Creative freedom and responsibility to shape processes and solutions in our global transformation
Continuous learning and development with tailored training and certification opportunities
Meal vouchers
Life and accident insurance
Option to include a premium private health insurance package as part of the flexible remuneration
A safe, stable and international workplace within a trusted family business that invests in people

Please only use the online application option.
Please note that we do not accept applications via recruitment agencies for this position.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Marija Kostadinovic.
One Passion. Many Opportunities.

Liebherr is a family-run technology company that is not only one of the largest construction machinery manufacturers in the world, but also offers high-quality, user-oriented products and services in many other areas. At Nextlane
, we don’t just develop software solutions – we create the future
of the automotive industry.

We are a company that combines advanced technology
with a clear vision: simplifying and digitizing
every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.

We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to develop
and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

Be part of a growth-oriented culture.
Collaborate with colleagues from all over the world.
Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.
Be committed to provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and collaborate on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate
, push boundaries
, and work on solutions that are transforming
the automotive world.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong expertise in C#/.NET, cloud-native backend development, and API engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services in cloud environments. The engineer will work closely with Tech Leads and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality solutions aligned with established architectural and engineering standards.

This role is not a Tech Lead or Architect position. The expectation is strong technical execution, active contribution to engineering quality, support for architecture compliance, and ownership of backend deliverables.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Your Responsibilities

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for:

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET Core.
Build secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs.
Implement backend solutions aligned with approved architectural patterns and technical guidelines.
Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.
Write optimized and maintainable database queries while ensuring data integrity and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve backend and production issues efficiently.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-ready code.
Apply SOLID principles and safeguard architectural practices such as Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Collaboration and Agile Development

Work closely with Tech Leads, frontend engineers, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Our Recruitment Process

15-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Interview with the Hiring Team
Technical Interview

What We Offer

We understand that flexibility and trust
are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

🏡 Hybrid Work: Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.
💰 Annual Payments: 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments + 1 summer bonus + 1 Christmas bonus in November).
🍽️ Meal Voucher: €10.20 per working day.
🌴 Vacation: 23 vacation days, plus 24th or 31st December off.
🗣️ Language Training: Access to group classes in Spanish, English, or French.
⚕️ Private Medical Insurance: Multicare coverage.
Teambuilding: Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where everyone feels valued and respected
. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
