jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Within MCAPS - Core, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

The purpose of this role is to provide technical support and advisory services for Azure DevOps, GitHub integrations, Microsoft Entra ID integrations, and related Developer Productivity solutions. The role is responsible for helping customers successfully adopt, operate, and optimize their DevOps environments by resolving complex technical issues, reducing business impact, and accelerating customer outcomes.

This position supports Microsoft's mission to empower every developer and organization to achieve more by delivering high-quality technical support across Azure DevOps services, including Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans, Artifacts, identity and access management, and connected developer platform technologies. The engineer will work closely with customers, engineering teams, and cross-functional support organizations to diagnose issues, drive resolution, share technical expertise, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

The role also plays a critical part in enhancing customer satisfaction, operational excellence, AI-enabled support transformation, knowledge sharing, and service readiness, ensuring customers can build, deploy, and manage applications securely and efficiently across Microsoft's developer ecosystem.

jobs.title: Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer (Celonis)(m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer(m/f/d)
, you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers.

You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

About The Role

Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data.
Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot).
Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes.
Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner).
Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability.
Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room.

About You

Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications.
Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it.
Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here).
Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries.
Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up.
Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.

What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About The Client

The leading provider of vehicle lifecycle solutions, with headquarters in Chicago, enables the companies that build, insure, and replace vehicles to power the next generation of transportation. Its platform delivers advanced mobile, artificial intelligence, and car technologies. It connects a network of 350+ insurance companies, 24,000+ repair facilities, hundreds of parts suppliers, and dozens of third-party data and service providers. The customer's collective solutions enhance productivity and help clients deliver better experiences for end consumers.

What You’ll Do

Design and evolve cloud-native architectures across the full platform stack — compute, API management, messaging, eventing, and data primarily on Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Services, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL); equivalent AWS services welcome, Azure preferred
Define and deliver predictable, resource-oriented REST APIs with a strong focus on performance, security, and developer usability
Apply microservice and domain-driven design (DDD) approaches to break large business domains into well-bounded services
Apply modern architectural patterns (e.g., event-driven, CQRS, serverless) for scalable and maintainable solutions
Produce and present architecture artifacts (sequence diagrams, domain models, data flow diagrams, AI workflows, and cloud blueprints) for both engineering and executive audiences
Provide technical leadership on cloud modernization, legacy-to-microservices migration, AI-readiness, and platform performance
Embed security and compliance practices across designs, including identity management, access control, and encryption
Work with product and data teams to integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, or comparable platforms) into core products and help drive AI-powered automation across the platform

For more information on the company, please visit our website or LinkedIn community .

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.
All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Role Overview :

Client is building a small, senior team of Forward Deployed Engineers to design and ship agentic AI applications across our Corporate Functions — Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Marketing and Sales operations. You will be embedded directly with the people who own the process, taking a real business problem from idea to a working, production-grade solution in weeks rather than quarters.
This is hands-on engineering. You will typically be the sole technical seat in a small pod alongside a process owner and a business sponsor, building applications that run multi-step workflows, hold state across many users, and act directly on enterprise systems of record. That is materially harder than a chatbot, and it is the point of the role.
You will build on Microsoft Fabric as our enterprise data platform and on Azure AI services, and you will help set the technical patterns the wider team reuses. If you want to build serious AI systems that change how a 50,000-person business actually works, and you want the autonomy to do it properly, this is the role.

What You Will Do:

Design, build and harden agentic AI applications that read from and write to enterprise systems of record, grounded on Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI services.
Embed with a Corporate Function team as the technical lead of a small, multi-functional pod — moving from problem, to prototype, to production at pace.
Run a tight, iterative build cycle: align on the outcome, prototype, gather feedback, refine and finalize, typically within one to two weeks per loop.
Own the quality of what you ship end to end — security, reliability, scalability, observability, and safe, governed write-back to source systems.
Make the right build call for the problem: low-code and agent-builder platforms where they fit, custom code where they do not.
Ensure the data behind each solution is AI-ready — modelled, governed and documented in Fabric, with lineage and access control that will stand up to audit.
Set and document the reusable technical patterns, components and guardrails the team applies across every engagement.
Become credible in a new business domain quickly and challenge requirements constructively to land on the right solution rather than the requested one.

Required Qualifications:

Proven experience building agentic or multi-agent AI systems that run in production and serve real users — working systems, not demonstrations.
Strong command of state management, concurrency, idempotency and authorization for systems that act on a system of record on behalf of many users.
Substantial software development experience in at least one language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C# or Java — you can architect, write, review and debug production code.
Hands-on integration experience with enterprise APIs and data platforms, including designing safe read and write paths and handling failure gracefully.
Working knowledge of modern AI application patterns — retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context design, agent orchestration, tool use and protocols such as MCP.
Strong, hands-on command of a major cloud platform, ideally Azure — able to independently provision, configure, deploy, secure and operate cloud resources, owning an application end to end rather than only consuming pre-built services.
Demonstrated ability to prototype rapidly, using AI-assisted development and fast iteration to turn a loosely defined idea into something usable in days.
The judgement and autonomy of a senior individual contributor — able to make sound architecture and feasibility calls alone, under time pressure, and explain them to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI and OneLake — or a comparable enterprise data platform.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, or agent-builder platforms such as Lyzr or Moveworks.
Integration experience with major Corporate Function systems of record — for example Oracle HCM, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics 365 or ServiceNow.
Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, data classification and residency, responsible AI policy, and evaluation of model output.
A background that blends software engineering with consulting, business transformation or a Corporate Function discipline.
Experience delivering in short, iterative cycles directly with non-technical business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Benefits

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme

Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Job Description

Would you like to challenge your software knowledge in a global company, to exchange ideas with skilled colleagues and work with cloud-native technologies? We are looking for interns to join our Software Products Department in BEUMER Group to help develop software solutions for airport and logistics customers around the world.

One team

Responsibilities

In Software Products we develop generic software products with a continuous focus on scalability, maintainability, quality and user value. As a software intern in Software Solutions, you will be part of a cross-functional team where you will be responsible for the entire software development lifecycle together with your team members. Your tasks could be:

Work with Unity to deliver a 3D visualization of live baggage handling systems.
Support in bringing CI/CD concepts to life,with automated tests for front-end and back-end
Create standard platform services such as logging, communication, etc. ( Platform as a Product )
Build microservices for our new baggage handling software
Work with Front-end development Angular, TypeScript and HTML5
Work with Back-end development in Java, C#, .NET 8+ and gRPC
Deep dive into cloud-native tools, such as GitLab, Docker, RabbitMQ, and Kubernetes.
As a natural part of development, we use AI tools like GitHub Copilot

Gain valuable experience in an open, motivating and software specialist environment.

You will be part of the team on equal terms with the rest of your colleagues and as such be involved in the development process.

You will be assigned a dedicated mentor who will ensure you have the support and tools and knowledge you need to get started, and who will be there to support you throughout the internship.

You will also have the opportunity to spend time with our interns from across the business, sharing your knowledge, experience and social event.

Interested?

If you are currently studying Software Engineering and are ready to start your internship in February 2027 - then get in touch with us.

The internship is paid and lasts appr. 5 months - the exact period will be agreed with your manager. And if both parties agree, it is possible to continue as student worker after the internship. Please apply online via the link as soon as possible, and no later than October 23rd. We will interview candidates on an ongoing basis and may hire candidates before the application deadline.

Please attach a copy of your recent grade sheet.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Talent Acquisition Lead, Søren Elkjær Holm, at +45 3176 0448.

We look forward to meeting you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Additional Information

If this is your first time applying or if you want to sharpen your CV and application further, we are offering you a free online course with the most important things to know in order to stand out.

The duration of the course is appr. 30 minutes - and you can easily choose between the topics to match your needs, as we would like to make it easier for you to succeed.

Click Here And Sign Up For Our Applicant Training

jobs.description:
Job Description

Would you like to be part of an innovative department, developing one of the best emulation software applications with the purpose of emulating and visualizing real-life and real-time baggage handling and sortation systems?

The application is used to our systems functionality-wise as well as visually before they are commissioned at customers across the globe and to ensure that our systems are of the highest quality.

You will be part of one of the two teams in the department, consisting of 5-6 Software Engineers each, working together based on SCRUM. Across the department we have a significant focus on close collaboration, knowledge-sharing and personal development. We are highly focused on creating a strong social environment in order to create the best results together as a team.

We Work With a Lot Of Different And Interesting Tasks Across The Department, And Some Of Things You Will Be Involved In Could Include

Development of intelligent 3D emulation software to emulate real-world sortation systems (C#)
Working innovatively with the newest technologies within digital twin, emulation and simulation
Develop high-level backend software with a close connection to the physical world in a solid code base
Develop test models and test environments to maintain and optimize our emulation models
Support and build tests on existing emulation models used in ongoing airport projects
Develop simulation models and calculations to verify customer requirements for our systems

Gain valuable experience in an open, motivating and software specialist environment.

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Software Engineer (.NET + Angular).

You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Advanced English is required.
Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
Proven experience developing production applications using C# and .NET.
Hands-on experience building modern web applications with Angular.
Strong understanding of TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET.
Solid understanding of front-end and backend integration, including reliable data flow between applications and services.
Experience working with relational databases and writing efficient SQL queries.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design principles, and clean, maintainable code.
Practical experience with unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting production applications.
Experience working with Git and modern software development practices.
Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product stakeholders, and other cross-functional team members.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

Competitive pay.
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
Continuing education opportunities.
Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As a BHS Software Engineer, you take ownership of baggage handling applications, production support, system integration and configuration for international airport installations. You work on mission-critical airport systems, solve complex operational issues and contribute to the reliability of baggage handling operations while collaborating with airport stakeholders, equipment vendors and international project teams.

At Equans, we believe that diverse talents strengthen our teams. We actively build an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome, can be themselves, and we encourage everyone to apply.

Your work location:
Machelen.

Zoom on the job:

act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues
perform root cause analysis on complex software issues related to baggage messaging, sortation control and workflow processing
prepare and present maintenance reports to airport stakeholders
collaborate with on-site technicians, airport IT teams and third-party equipment suppliers to resolve cross-system issues
lead the technical integration between EDAS software and third-party baggage handling systems
develop and maintain connectors between BHS applications and industrial equipment such as sorters, conveyors and scanners
configure security settings, resolve communication protocol issues and ensure reliable production data flows
configure and maintain baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
design and test high-availability and redundancy configurations
provide 2nd and 3rd line support across the EDAS BHS application suite
work with message brokers, IATA messaging standards and real-time data processing pipelines
work with industrial communication protocols including OPC UA and IATA 1745 BSM messaging
maintain sortation allocation interfaces for real-time baggage routing
troubleshoot workflow engines, message broker integrations and sortation logic
integrate systems with airline departure control systems and baggage reconciliation platforms
maintain technical documentation including configuration documents, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides and operational runbooks
document connector behaviour, deployment procedures and redundancy configurations
contribute to knowledge sharing and the internal knowledge base
identify recurring issues and implement permanent improvements
contribute to software stabilisation initiatives across the application portfolio
participate in test environment development and virtual airport test platforms
contribute to software refactoring activities to improve maintainability and code quality

Come as you are, ideally with:

bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers
experience with C# (.NET Framework/.NET Core), Python, PowerShell or Bash
knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, stored procedures, database performance tuning and data migration processes
experience with Windows Server and Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux/CentOS) administration
familiarity with VMware, Hyper‑V, VPN, RDP, SSH and secure remote connectivity
experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, CI/CD concepts, Docker, Jira and Confluence
understanding of network troubleshooting, firewalls, TLS/SSL and industrial network segmentation
knowledge of baggage handling architecture, SAC systems, BMR, airline DCS integration and IATA airport operations standards
able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with customers, partners and colleagues
organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required
knowledge of French (both written and spoken — valuable for communication with many airport stakeholders)

What if you became BHS Software Engineer at Equans?

For you this means:

a market rate salary in line with your education and experience
interesting training and career opportunities
group insurance, hospitalization insurance
eco vouchers, meal vouchers, representation allowance, 13th month, holiday pay
electrical lease car, bicycle lease plan
smartphone with subscription, internet fee
additional paid leave, seniority leave, homeworking
discounts through Benefits@Work (culture, sports, travel, and more)

About Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)

Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) is the BHS (Baggage Handling System) software unit within Equans Belux. We design, develop, deploy, and maintain mission-critical software solutions for airport baggage handling systems worldwide — serving airports across Europe, North America, Africa, and the Middle East.

As part of Equans ICT, we combine deep domain expertise in airport logistics with modern software engineering practices. Our team of 9 developers works closely with project managers, support engineers, and on-site technicians to deliver reliable, high-availability systems that keep baggage flowing 24/7.

We are currently undertaking a significant transformation program focused on software stabilization, CI/CD automation, remote access platform development, and test environment modernization — you will be joining at an exciting time of technical renewal.

Aufgaben

Entwicklung und Wartung von Backend-Systemen:
Du entwickelst und pflegst robuste und skalierbare Backend-Lösungen mit Python und Django, die die Grundlage für unsere Chatbot-Plattform bilden.

Web-Technologien wie HTTP, REST, WebSockets und GRPC, um reibungslose

Kommunikation und Datenflüsse sicherzustellen.

Architektur und Design:
Du entwirfst und implementierst skalierbare

Softwarearchitekturen, die den Anforderungen einer wachsenden Nutzerbasis gerecht werden.

ADENES Group is a European leader in loss adjustment, operating across 9 countries with over 5,000 employees and 1,600 field experts. We intervene before, during and after claims events to deliver the best possible support to insurers and policyholders alike. Our mission is built on expertise, trust, and the continuous improvement of the claims experience.

The role

As part of the expansion of our IT hub in Porto, we are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer to join our Innovation & IT Projects Department. You will work within a small, hands-on engineering team that builds and maintains the proprietary digital tools our business relies on every day, from claims management platforms to internal operational applications.

This is an in-house product role: you will work directly with business units, translate real operational needs into technical solutions, and take ownership of your deliverables from design through to production.

Design, develop and maintain backend and frontend features across multiple products.
Collaborate with product owners and business teams to understand requirements and deliver quality solutions.

Additionally, you will work with your team members to help them develop and achieve their personal and organizational career goals.

Lead the definition, architecture design, development, testing, delivery, and support of business applications using one or more development platforms/applications in the IT-CCO Domain.

Collaborate with other teams to design software architecture and write scalable code.

Writing stored procedures and functions in Azure SQL Database.
Participate in requirements analysis and provide technical guidance to stakeholders.
Execute test plan updates, and test scenario execution.
Collaborate with Architecture and Integrations team members to develop best practices and methodologies.
Oversight and alignment on the entire Asset management environment, including design, development, maintenance and support.
Enhance the current CI/CD processes to support new and existing development.
Expected to perform bug fix and/or enhancement requests.
Ensures that deliveries by the team is supported with proper documentation

Participate in day-to-day maintenance of several application systems in operation, including identifying and troubleshooting application issues. .

new_jobs.title: .NET SharePoint developer
new_jobs.description:
Hoe zorg jij ervoor dat duizenden collega’s binnen de Rechtspraak elke dag soepel (samen)werken? Als full-stack developer bij IVO Rechtspraak bouw je applicaties die dat mogelijk maken: van intranet en kennisdeling tot digitale handtekeningen en nieuwe tools voor samenwerking. Jouw oplossingen hebben impact. En je ideeën worden gewaardeerd!

Wat ga je doen bij IVO Rechtspraak?

Jij versterkt het DevOps-team “Kennis en Samenwerken”. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren jullie toepassingen die de hele organisatie draaiende houden. Je werkt aan bestaande SharePoint-oplossingen en bouwt nieuwe, generieke applicaties die de volgende stap in digitalisering mogelijk maken.

Houd je van variatie en uitdaging? Dan zit je hier goed. De ene dag verfijn je een applicatie die al jaren in gebruik is of analyseer je een incident. De andere dag bouw je een nieuw systeem vanaf nul.

Het ene moment werk je aan de front-end in Angular, het volgende moment bouw je een API in .NET – en alles wat daar tussenin zit. Je overlegt met architecten over technische keuzes, maar schakelt even vlot met gebruikers door de hele organisatie. Je werkt agile, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Jouw inbreng als senior telt: je ervaring, je ideeën, je voorstellen voor oplossingsrichtingen. Wil je ook buiten je team kennis delen? Sluit je dan aan bij onze vakgroepen, bijvoorbeeld voor ontwikkelaars, architectuur of security & privacy.

Ben jij een ervaren full-stack developer die graag het voortouw neemt? Praat je net zo makkelijk met een rechter als met een architect? En vind je maatschappelijke impact minstens zo belangrijk als techniek? Dan is dit jouw volgende stap.

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1.008 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie- en 64 keuzebudget-uren op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer.
Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p-direkt.nl (http://www.p-direkt.nl/).

Wat we van jou verwachten

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het programmeren met het .NET-platform, inclusief het ontwikkelen van backend oplossingen voor SharePoint-integraties (zowel on-premise als in M365)
Ervaring met front-end technologieën zoals Angular
Kennis van en ervaring met SharePoint (SPFx)- en PnP- Framework
Kennis van en ervaring met het toepassen van standaarden voor digitale toegankelijkheid (WCAG)

Kom je bij ons werken, dan vragen we ook altijd een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

Hier kom je te werken

Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Zo zorgen we dat rechtszaken iedere dag soepel verlopen. Onze kernwaarde integriteit is verweven in het DNA van al onze medewerkers. Van IT’er tot communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Daarom vinden wij het ook belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt, plezier heeft in het werk en zichzelf kan zijn in een informele werksfeer.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
to join the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team
at DataSnipper!

In this role, you'll be responsible for designing and building core platform systems
that power authentication, authorization, and access across our entire product. You’ll play a key role in shaping the architecture of our platform and enabling other teams to build on top of it.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What You Will Do

Design and build scalable, secure IAM (authentication, authorization, access management) platform services
Own and drive architecture decisions for backend systems
Work across teams to enable identity and access flows across the platform
Ensure high reliability, performance, and security
Handle ambiguous, high-level problems and turn them into structured solutions
Collaborate with stakeholders and communicate technical decisions and risks clearly
Participate in an on-call rotation (second line after tech support)

What You Bring

7+ years of backend development experience (C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, etc.)
Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)
Proven track record of building scalable, reliable systems
Experience with system design and architecture
Strong communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders
Bias to action and sense of ownership
Ability to work independently on complex and ambiguous problems
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices
Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools
Wealth of experience around testing and various methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Identity & Access Management systems
Strong understanding of security and authorization models
Experience with microservices architecture
Familiarity with container services (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience working in platform teams
Experience working in startups or scaleups

What We Offer

Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands
Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us
28 vacation days on a full-time basis
Excellent salary
Pension plan
Stock participation plan
Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in Amsterdam)
International working environment
Daily lunch provided by our in-house chef 🍽️
Access to OpenUp (mental health platform)
Friday drinks and team events 🤩

Recruiter screen

Peer programming session
System design interview
Final interviews with Engineering leadership

new_jobs.title: Medior Thinkwise Developer
new_jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Medior Thinkwise Developer
Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw Thinkwise-team binnen Centric?

Als Medior Thinkwise Developer krijg je de kans om niet alleen software te ontwikkelen, maar ook actief mee te bouwen aan een nieuw expertisegebied binnen Centric. Samen met een groeiend team werk je aan innovatieve klantprojecten waarin organisaties hun bestaande applicaties moderniseren of volledig nieuwe bedrijfsoplossingen realiseren met Thinkwise.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, kennisdeling en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Omdat het team nog volop in ontwikkeling is, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te denken over werkwijzen, standaarden en de toekomst van onze Thinkwise-practice.

Wat jij doet

Als Medior Thinkwise Developer werk je aan projecten waarin bedrijfsprocessen worden vertaald naar moderne, schaalbare softwareoplossingen. Je analyseert processen, ontwerpt datamodellen en ontwikkelt functionaliteit binnen het Thinkwise-platform.Je werkt nauw samen met consultants, architecten, klanten en collega-developers om oplossingen te realiseren die niet alleen technisch sterk zijn, maar ook daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor de gebruiker.

Jouw werkzaamheden

Ontwikkelen van bedrijfsapplicaties met Thinkwise.
Werken aan nieuwbouw- en moderniseringsprojecten.
Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar datamodellen, schermen, taken en business rules.
Ontwerpen en optimaliseren van SQL-logica.
Realiseren van koppelingen met externe systemen en API’s.
Testen, documenteren en verbeteren van oplossingen.
Actief deelnemen aan Agile/Scrum-projectteams.
Sparren met klanten over functionele vraagstukken.
Signaleren van verbeterkansen in functionaliteit, performance en gebruiksvriendelijkheid.
Bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team.

Vereisten

Wat breng jij mee?

HBO werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Thinkwise of een vergelijkbaar low-code/model-driven platform.
Goede kennis van SQL en relationele databases.
Ervaring met datamodellering.
Affiniteit met bedrijfsprocessen en softwareontwikkeling.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
Zelfstandige en proactieve werkhouding.
Ervaring met Agile/Scrum.

Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring met REST API’s, OData of andere integraties.
Ervaring met ERP-systemen.
Ervaring met softwaremodernisering of migratietrajecten.
Kennis van Azure DevOps of CI/CD.

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij Centric krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een organisatie waar technologie en ondernemerschap samenkomen.

Je kunt rekenen op:

Een salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
Direct een vast contract behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.
Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken.
Laptop en telefoon.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developers
to support the MODES III program. This individual will design, develop, modernize, test, integrate, and maintain secure enterprise web applications supporting Department of Defense mission requirements. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, modern front-end and back-end technologies, RESTful APIs, cloud-hosted applications, and Agile/DevSecOps delivery in a fast-paced Federal environment.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain responsive enterprise web applications.
Develop reusable front-end components and scalable back-end services using approved frameworks and coding standards.
Translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable software solutions.
Troubleshoot defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support production issue resolution.

Oracle APEX and Database Development

Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Oracle APEX applications supporting MODES III business processes.
Develop and optimize Oracle SQL, PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects.
Integrate Oracle APEX applications with enterprise systems and RESTful services using Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS).
Support modernization or migration of legacy applications into Oracle APEX solutions.

API, Integration, and Cloud Support

Design, build, document, and maintain secure RESTful APIs and system integrations.
Support application deployment and operations in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to improve CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and deployment automation.
Assist with application performance monitoring, tuning, availability, and reliability.

Cybersecurity, Quality, and Compliance

Apply secure software development practices and participate in code reviews, automated testing, and vulnerability remediation.
Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, and Authority to Operate requirements.
Develop accessible applications and content consistent with Section 508 requirements.

Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration

Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, UX specialists, architects, testers, and Government stakeholders.
Provide work estimates, technical documentation, status updates, and knowledge transfer.

The Full Stack Developer will help modernize and sustain MODES III applications that support military members and their families. The role combines hands-on Oracle APEX development, cloud application engineering, secure software delivery, and close collaboration with Government and program stakeholders to deliver reliable, accessible, and mission-focused digital services.

Qualifications

Must hold an active Secret clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
Minimum 10+ years of enterprise software development experience, including 3+ years performing full stack development.
Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and maintaining Oracle APEX applications in an enterprise environment.
Strong experience with Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, ORDS, and RESTful service integration.
Experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and at least one modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Experience with one or more back-end technologies such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js, or Python.
Experience using Git-based source control, issue tracking, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.
Experience supporting cloud-hosted applications in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

CompTIA Security+ certification is preferred.
Experience supporting Federal or Department of War programs.
Experience operating in IL4/IL5 or other regulated cloud environments.
Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, microservices, container technologies, and infrastructure as code.
Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, AWS, or Agile-related certifications are preferred.
Experience with SonarQube, Checkmarx, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Docker, or Kubernetes is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams while managing multiple priorities.
Self-starter with strong attention to detail, customer focus, and commitment to software quality and mission outcomes.

Dit ga je doen

Jij loopt voor de troepen uit en bent bezig met de technische oplossingen en integratie van applicaties voor de Rechtspraak. Hoe pakken we bepaalde vraagstukken aan, bijvoorbeeld met containerplatforms, microservices of object-based storage? Hoe gaan we om met systeemkoppelingen? En welke eisen stellen we, by design, aan de kwaliteit en veiligheid? Met de overgang naar de cloud en een zero trust architectuur ligt de lat hoog.

Jij werkt voor een of meer van onze DevOps-teams aan de architectuur van diverse applicaties die we zelf ontwikkelen, beheren en voortdurend vernieuwen. Denk aan toepassingen voor digitale rechtzaakdossiers, het uitwisselen van berichten of aan webportalen die externe partijen toegang geven tot onze informatie. Je zet het ontwerp in grote lijnen voor ze uit in een solution architectuur design en beantwoordt vragen bij de detailinvulling. Zo kunnen we agile werken aan een just-in-time architectuur.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ál onze architecten bij IVO Rechtspraak, dat geeft een extra dimensie aan je werk. Jullie zorgen voor samenhang binnen de totale architectuur van de Rechtspraak. Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

new_jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
new_jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.

Senior Software Developer - .Net / C# - 100% Remote

Are you the kind of developer who sees something that's not quite right and just…owns it, rather than waiting to be told to fix it?

(This isn't a role for someone who wants tickets pointed at them and to be left alone. The team already has plenty of people who can execute - what's missing is someone who steps back, sees the bigger picture, and makes the call)

We're working with an established public sector-facing transport technology business, fully remote, with a small, close-knit engineering team building consumer-facing apps (built on .NET MAUI, so a single C#/.NET codebase across platforms) backed by a .NET Core API. The business is growing - new regional contracts are coming online that will substantially increase revenue over the next few years - but it's stayed a genuinely low-pressure, low-turnover place to work. People who join tend to still be there years later.

What you'll be doing:

Taking real ownership of features across the app and API - not just building to spec, but deciding what "right" looks like and pushing back when something isn't
Picking up pieces of work and seeing them through to completion without needing to be pointed in the right direction at every step
Stepping back from the code to look at the holistic picture - is this UI pattern actually good, is this the right way to solve the problem, not just "does it technically work"
Working alongside 4-5 other developers of mixed experience, helping steer decisions rather than just adding to the pile of individually-reasonable-but-inconsistent choices
Working across a MAUI-based app and its .NET Core / C# API - genuine full-stack ownership within the .NET ecosystem

What they're looking for:

Strong, proven C#/.NET development experience - this is the core skill the role is built around, not a secondary strength
A genuine ownership mentality - comfortable making the call and living with it, rather than waiting to be told
Enough experience to see the bigger picture across a codebase or feature, not just execute the ticket in front of you
Someone who's past chasing the next big salary bump or the next big title - this is a steady, long-term role for someone who knows what matters to them (good work-life balance, 100% remote, flexibility, no overtime or weekend work)

Advantageous, not essential:

Experience with .NET MAUI, Xamarin, or another cross-platform C#/.NET mobile framework
Comfortable with SQL Server (though there's already dedicated support for this, so it's not a core requirement)
Experience working in a small team where you're one of a handful of developers, not one of fifty

The kind of person who'll do well here:

You'd rather have a stable, sustainable working life than chase pace or cutting-edge tech for its own sake - this team finishes at 5.00pm, and means it
You're happy being trusted to own things without needing a bigger title to justify it
You care enough about the detail - a clunky bit of UI, a pattern being copied without being questioned - to fix it even when nobody's asked
You want to still be here in years, not months - this business is known for keeping people, and they're looking for someone who wants that too

Why this is worth a look:

This is a genuinely stable, well-funded business - revenue is set to rise significantly over the next few years as new contracts land - that has never had a problem keeping hold of good people. It's fully remote, properly low-pressure, and offers the kind of ownership that's usually reserved for a "lead" title, without the politics that title normally comes with.

If you want to be the person who decides what "right" looks like, rather than just building to someone else's decision, this is worth a conversation.
