new_jobs.title: Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Leading & Directly managing a cross functional team of 8-12 engineers
Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

What We Are Looking For

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment
A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software
Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.
Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners
Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases
Work effectively in an agile environment, using its practices to deliver value consistently and adapt quickly
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Our Tech Stack

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You’ll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €68,400 to €101,250 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
25 days paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
Additional health & dental insurance
Mental wellbeing platform
Fully covered Multisports card
Food vouchers
Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
WFH equipment allowance
Flexible working from home
Sabbatical Leave
Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job 

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React. 

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Job Requirements

Required skills:

3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset 
Experience with Git  

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have): 

Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. About the role

In this role, you’ll contribute directly to Axon™
, our Digital Twin SaaS platform. We’re looking for Software Engineers who are curious, analytically strong, and excited to grow in an intellectually challenging product environment.

A background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field will provide a strong foundation for success in this role. Beyond that, we value strong reasoning skills, an interest in software development, and the ambition to continuously learn and improve.

You join the backend Analytics team within Product & Engineering: a close‑knit team of 20+ data scientists and engineers working closely with product owners to deliver end‑to‑end platform features.
You help build and evolve the analytical backbone of the Axon platform.
You translate strong abstract and analytical thinking into real‑world software solutions.
You integrate customer data into scalable data models, building complex graph structures, analytical logic, and advanced capabilities for calculations, simulations, and querying.
You know what clean, production‑ready code looks like. You have a strong focus on quality and maintainability.
You build and extend a sophisticated backend, using .NET.
You use AI -curiously and with judgement- to explore design options, write and improve code, validate tests, and speed up repetitive work.
You’ll report to the Lead Software Engineer of Axon technology.

Job Requirements

About you

We value people with a strong technical foundation, a growth mindset, curiosity, and the drive to build solutions that create real impact.

Have a strong analytical and abstract reasoning mindset and enjoy mathematics, complex systems, and intellectual challenges.
Hold a master’s degree in fields such as (Civil) Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or similar.
Have a strong interest in software development . Prior development experience is a big plus, but not required.
Are curious about how AI is reshaping software development and eager to grow with it.
Enjoy understanding how technical choices connect to real business impact.
Are fluent in Dutch & English.
Feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind!

Why join us?

Strong onboarding, daily collaboration and coaching by experienced engineers to help you grow fast.
The chance to build a strong foundation for your software engineering career.
Work on one growing SaaS product, instead of jumping from one short project to another.
Build deep product and technical knowledge over time, so you can become an expert faster.
High-impact work on real-life, complex supply chain problems.
An intellectually challenging environment where deep thinking is valued.
AI-enabled development that helps you focus on creativity, problem-solving, and quality.
A fun culture that values ownership, curiosity, kindness, and helping each other succeed.
Flexible working hours and a 50/50 hybrid model from our Mechelen office.
Alongside a competitive salary and bonus, you'll have the choice between a flexible mobility budget or an electric company car with convenient charging facilities.

About us

Start your career shaping the future of supply chains.

Bluecrux is a value chain consulting and technology company, specializing in transformative solutions for today’s complex supply chain landscape. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we’re committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Axon
helps companies bring scattered supply chain data together in one clear view, so our clients can better understand what is happening, make smarter decisions, and act faster. Our platform is used especially in Life Sciences and Healthcare, where supply chains are highly complex, and decisions can directly impact product launches, availability, and access to medicines. By helping companies see their supply chain more clearly, Axon supports faster product launches, better use of working capital, and more room for investment in research and development.

Axon is also still in a scale-up phase. There is a strong product vision, many new ideas to build, and a lot of product innovation still ahead.

LE STAGE

As-tu une passion pour l’informatique et/ou les télécommunications? Alors Infrabel est peut-être fait pour toi!

En tant que Stagiaire Développeur·euse Fullstack Java/Angular, tu participes activement au développement d’un Access Check Tool, constitué d’un backend Java et d’un frontend Angular. Cette application web permettra de centraliser et de consulter les accès des collaborateurs de l’équipe aux différents outils et plateformes ICT internes.

Actuellement, ces informations sont gérées manuellement dans un fichier Excel. L’Access Check Tool doit remplacer ce fichier par une interface web claire, structurée et facile à utiliser.

L’outil offrira une vue d’ensemble des accès de l’équipe et facilitera leur suivi lors de l’arrivée d’un collaborateur, d’un changement d’équipe ou de rôle, d’une revue périodique des accès et d’un départ.

Description Du Projet Et De Tes Tâches

Analyse des besoins
Analyser le fichier Excel existant, identifier les informations à reprendre et définir les besoins prioritaires avec les utilisateurs concernés.
Concevoir le modèle de données et les interfaces API REST.
Réaliser des maquettes (mock-ups) des principales pages web.

Développement de l’Access Check Tool
Développer le backend en Java avec Spring Boot.
Développer le frontend en Angular afin de consulter et de gérer facilement les accès de l’équipe.
Permettre la recherche et le filtrage des informations par collaborateur, équipe, outil ou type d’accès.
Prévoir l’ajout, la modification et la désactivation de collaborateurs ainsi que la mise à jour manuelle de leurs accès.
Mettre en place des tests unitaires et fonctionnels et participer à des revues de code avec les développeurs expérimentés.

Validation et sécurité
Intégrer une authentification d’entreprise et une gestion appropriée des rôles et autorisations.
Vérifier la conformité du MVP avec les standards de sécurité, de qualité et de performance applicables.

Documentation et communication
Rédiger une documentation technique claire sur l’architecture et le fonctionnement de l’outil.
Documenter les API ainsi que les procédures d’installation, de configuration et de maintenance.
Présenter le projet, ses objectifs et les résultats obtenus aux équipes techniques concernées.
Préparer une présentation synthétique à destination du management.

We are looking for an AI Engineer with a strong Microsoft technology background. The role
Toga EMEA is looking for a Solution Architect to act as design authority on a customer-facing web portal. The portal sits over a live Oracle 19c system of record, and it has to work without changing that system. You own the interface between the two.

The 68 days are heaviest in the first seven weeks, while the design is set. After that, the role is design authority: you review the build; you do not write it.

The technical specification and integration design — architecture, hosting, database, scalability and business continuity.

Role-based access control across several organisations sharing one portal.

Single sign-on with the client's existing identity setup, and an audit trail that records who changed what, before and after, and when.

10+ years in software, 4+ of them as an architect.

Oracle 19c data modelling and PL/SQL.
REST APIs specified in OpenAPI 3.0.
Load-balanced IIS and high-availability design on Windows Server.
Security architecture across TLS 1.2+, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to defend a design in front of a client.

USD 463 per day for days worked, invoiced monthly and paid 15 days after the client pays Toga.
Work visa, flights and hotel for on-site days are arranged and paid by Toga EMEA.

new_jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect Pre Sales (UAE)
new_jobs.description:
Role purpose

The AI Solution Engineer is a senior, hands-on member of the pre-sales team responsible for shaping credible enterprise AI solutions and proving that they can work. The role combines technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, estimation and client presentation. The successful candidate must be able to move comfortably from an executive use-case discussion to building and demonstrating a working solution on the Microsoft AI stack.

Please note, this role is open to candidates based in both the UAE and India locations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead technical discovery with client business, data, security and technology stakeholders; convert business priorities into qualified AI use cases, solution requirements and a practical delivery approach.
• Design secure, scalable enterprise architectures for generative AI, agentic AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, document intelligence and AI-enabled applications using the Microsoft cloud stack.
• Build working demonstrations, accelerators and proof-of-concepts using production-relevant patterns not only mock-ups to validate feasibility, user experience, integration and expected value.
• Own the technical workstream of RFPs, RFIs and proposals, including architecture, solution narrative, scope, assumptions, dependencies, non-functional requirements, effort estimates, bill of materials and delivery risks.
• Define RAG, grounding, tool-use, memory, orchestration, evaluation, observability and human-in-the-loop patterns appropriate to each use case.
• Assess model and platform choices across quality, latency, throughput, security, data residency, responsible AI and cost; explain the trade-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
• Present solutions in workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations and bid presentations; respond credibly to detailed questions from enterprise architecture, cybersecurity and procurement teams.
• Work with account, industry and delivery teams to shape opportunities, identify reusable assets and position differentiators without overcommitting scope or capability.
• Support technical due diligence, implementation planning and handover after award, ensuring that proposal commitments are understood, feasible and traceable into delivery.
• Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft AI services, reference architectures, licensing and emerging agentic patterns, and turn that knowledge into reusable pre-sales assets.

Required experience and capabilities

• 10+ years of professional experience across software engineering, cloud architecture, AI/ML engineering or enterprise solution consulting.
• At least 5 years of hands-on experience specifically designing and building generative AI solutions using large language models, including enterprise RAG and/or AI agents.
• Demonstrable experience delivering AI or advanced analytics solutions beyond proof-of-concept stage, with a strong understanding of production engineering, security, monitoring and operational support.
• Strong hands-on development capability in Python and APIs/SDKs; experience with C#/.NET is advantageous.
• Deep understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
• Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, document repositories and identity platforms.
• Strong knowledge of cloud security, Entra ID, managed identities, private networking, secrets management, role-based access control, data privacy and responsible AI controls.
• Proven client-facing experience in discovery, solution presentations, technical writing, estimation and proposal development for complex enterprise opportunities.
• Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, sequence flows, assumptions, sizing models and implementation plans under bid deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal English; able to challenge requirements constructively and communicate complex concepts without unnecessary jargon.

Preferred qualifications

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or equivalent current Microsoft credentials.
• Experience in regulated or government environments, including security review, data residency and private-cloud/hybrid integration requirements.
• Experience estimating Azure AI consumption, model throughput/capacity, search capacity, infrastructure and licensing for commercial proposals.
• Experience creating reusable accelerators, reference architectures or demo environments for an AI consulting or technology pre-sales organisation.
